notes.title: Tony Replaces Eliza in Rotation + a Dev Report!
notes.content:
[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/KreepySargeTony610x252.jpg]

First things first - we’re moving Eliza out of rotation so she can restock her supply of noxious gases and bringing in Tony to take her place on the back line. Tony joins Kreepy and Sarge this week in the free to play rotation slots.

[h1]Dev progress report[/h1]
May is full of national holidays around Block N Load land, so the team is in and out this month working on a variety of things for our next updates. If you have visited the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/11/]Player Test Realm subforum[/url] here on Steam, you’ll see that we’re working through some more balance changes for some of our heroes. Get on over there if you want a peek or just want your opinions heard.

As you will have read in our update last week, we want to get some more content in the shop for you to buy. Skins and heroes have the highest development impact since there are more team members involved in this, so producing these takes a little longer than some other features. Currently we’ve got a number of ideas waiting for a concept artist to work through them. Once we’ve got concepts to work from, we’ll get the artists, animators and modellers working.

Another item on our roadmap is more events like last weekend’s Double XP weekend. Did you play and earn your double XP? Is it enough to get you back playing more often? Let us know as we’ll be experimenting with various ways to get players back in the game.

Let’s recap this year’s roadmap as it looks this week:

[list][*]Separating Casual and Ranked - Done 
[*]Block Rebalance Pass 1 - Done 
[*]Progression Overhaul - Done 
[*]Hero Balance Passes – On-going alongside development work
[*]New Tutorial/Hero Tutorials - In progress
[*]More sales and short term events 
- Bundle Support - In Progress
- Double XP weekends - One down, more to plan!
- Free Hero weekends - Scheduled (but it’s a secret)
- Flash sales - Scheduled
[*]More cosmetic content - In Progress
[*]Performance, Bug and Quality of Life fixes (including matchmaking improvements) - this is always on-going[/list]

As for our feature development work, we’ve got a general order of attack (which could change as a result of other dependencies): 

[list][*]Squad finder – A way to find other players looking to join a squad before entering the queue to help find people to group up with before starting the match. 
[*]Improved Map Voting
[*]Seasonal (and other criteria) Ranked leaderboards 
[*]Ranked promotion/demotion systems 
[*]Custom game improvements - Late joining, additional custom game options, etc
[*]In-game communication improvements - Map ping system 
[*]Clan System - Persistent clans or clan identification[/list]

[h1]Asia and Oceania server merge[/h1]
Sadly, neither the Oceania nor the Asia regions are proving particularly viable from a userbase point of view and leaving both open simply causes confusion for new players who are unable to find matches on either. Rather than shut both down, we plan to “merge” them. In real terms, there are no regional datacentres geographically located that are good for both Asia and Oceania, but by calling the region server “Asia-Pacific” we hope to encourage players from that side of the globe to play together. Since many players already choose the North American region as an alternative, we believe the experience won't be any worse at least. 

On the 24th of May, only one server - Asia-Pacific - will be available in the eastern hemisphere. 

[h1]Ranked beta[/h1]
This coming weekend (13 to 15 May), ranked mode moves to solo queue only with the level requirement raised to 30. We’ll be looking for your experiences with ranked matchmaking as solo players as we work on getting the settings for Ranked to be the best possible.

notes.title: Update 2.7 Ranked Mode
notes.content:
[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2.7UpdateApril2016_616x353.jpg]


Version 2.7 brings the eagerly anticipated Block skins to the Block N Load Arenas along with an overhauled progression system to go with it.


Other highlights include:
•	Separate Ranked Beta mode.
•	New Hero progression rewards.
•	Changes to Roly and Tony's weapons.

[h1]Casual and Ranked Beta[/h1]
Previously all players in Block N Load were entered in to one mode “Classic” which mixed together players who wanted a heavily competitive experience, and those who wanted to play without quite so much pressure. We’ve split Classic into two modes, both of which have their own set of rules, which we'll experiment with over the course of the Beta. We'll keep you posted as to any changes as we go.

Ranked will only be available at weekends initially. Check out the Play Screen Game Mode selector for dates and times in your region.

[h1]Gold Bar Rewards[/h1]
Gold Bars awards now take in to account the length of the match, up to a cap.

[h1]Progression[/h1]

[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2.7Updateapril2016_680X284.png]

We’ve made some quite significant changes to the Hero progression systems. Block Skins are back and you can get them by leveling up your heroes to 10 and 50 where you'll unlock block skins that can be used by any Hero that can take that Block into battle. We've also added more badges and titles for you to earn. 

[h1]Heroes[/h1]
[b]Roly Poly Fat Fat[/b]
Roly’s Booster system (her secondary weapon) and Hero Block have both had some significant changes made to them.

[u]Booster Vent[/u]
Roly's secondary weapon's alt-fire now creates puddles of bubbling Toxic Goo trailing behind her. Use it to deny enemy access or help an escape.

[u]Toxic Waste[/u]
When Roly’s Hero Block is detonated it too will coat the area around it with splodges of seething Toxic Goo.

[u]Toxic Goo[/u]
Friendly goo is blue, while pink enemy Goo poisons and slows foes. Toxic Goo doesn’t hang around forever though - as enemy Heroes pass through it the Toxic Goo will be slowly used up, and eventually destroyed.

[b]Tony Turretto[/b]
The way the shots from the Rivet Gun scatter has been changed.  Previously the pellets from the Rivet Gun would form tight clusters.  This often meant that you would either hit with all the pellets or you would miss all of them.  The pellets from the Rivet Gun now scatter more randomly within its cone of fire.

[b]Additional Improvements and Fixes[/b]
We’ve also been fixing some bugs and improving other areas of the game.

Check out the [url=https://www.blocknload.com/article/update-notes-2-7/]Full Patch Notes[/url] for every little detail!

P.S., if you managed to qualify for Bronze league in our previous league system, you'll have a sweet Sweet Science Promo skin waiting for you. And because clothes really do maketh the man, Sweet Science, the man himself, is on sale for 50% off the Platinum price until Monday, 5pm BST.

notes.title: Rotation Changes and an Update!
notes.content:
[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/KreepySargeElizaRotation_small2.jpg]

We hope you’re enjoying the new progression, the new match awards and had a weekend full of ranked goodness with your friends! We’re not stopping there, of course, and today we’re bringing you an update on our Roadmap progress and what’s in the pipeline next. But first, let’s get a couple of announcements out of the way.

[h1]Hero Rotation and Time Assault[/h1]
We’re changing to a Tuesday Rotation day so today we’re bringing Kreepy the Klown to our Free Rotation, joining Sarge and Eliza. This Dream Team gives you some extra oomph in your mid-field attacks where Kreepy can keep ‘em laughing with banana mayhem while Eliza makes those laughs their last. Meanwhile get Sarge pushing forward and take that base!

You'll also find the Time Assault is reset and Nigel’s “Raiders of the Lost Block” arena is ready to go.

[h1]Roadmap Update[/h1]
Since the beginning of the year, we’ve been learning more and more about how players are playing the game both long and short term. We’ve also learned a lot about our workload capacity and we’re getting into a release pattern we can sustain. Over the last 3 months, we’ve done the following (along with numerous bug and quality of life fixes):

[list][*]Separating Casual and Ranked - Done
[*]Block Rebalance Pass 1 - Done
[*]Progression Overhaul - Done
[*]Hero Balance Passes – on-going (Hero Balance is something that we keep a constant eye on. We’re watching the balance of power as it shifts from hero to hero in response to new players and veteran players learning new tactics or changing up old ones.)
[*]Performance fixes - On-going (We’ve made some small improvements and are continuing to investigate other ways to improve performance on various systems.)
[*]New Tutorial/Hero Tutorials - In progress (We’ve added functionality to teach about the build phase barrier.  Supply and Blockbuster drops are on the way as we continue to refine the tutorial and we will be looking to add hero tutorials over time.)[/list]

Now we look forward to the summer and we’ve got a few other things on our immediate radar:

[list][*]More sales and short term events - we’re looking at Bundles, Double XP weekends, Free Hero weekends and Flash sales as ways to get new and old players playing for longer and buying more.
[*]More cosmetic content - we want to add more to buy and more rewards (yes, level 100 Block skins!). Again, we believe that having things to work towards really keeps people coming back, and of course, more things to sell helps our bottom line!
[*]Bug and Quality of Life fixes - this is always on-going[/list]

As for our feature development work, we want to focus on key areas:

[list][*]Encourage friendly and competitive team play and communication
[*]Do as much as we can to help new players understand the depth and strategic elements of the game
[*]Keep working towards better matchmaking at all levels[/list]

As a result, we’ve identified the following big features we’ll be working on. The order will depend on the full scope of the designs and other dependencies and we’ll update you on the particulars soon:

[*]Squad finder – A way to find other players looking to join a squad before entering the queue to help find people to group up with before starting the match.
[*]Matchmaking Improvements to include better squad matching
[*]In-game communication improvements - Map ping system
[*]Seasonal (and other criteria) Ranked leaderboards 
[*]Ranked promotion/demotion systems
[*]Clan System - Persistent clans or clan identification
[*]Custom game improvements - Late joining, additional custom game options, etc[/list]

What do you think of these bigger features and which do you think are most important? We’d love to hear your feedback!

notes.title: Update 2.7 Ranked Mode
notes.content:
[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2.7UpdateApril2016_616x353.jpg]


Version 2.7 brings the eagerly anticipated Block skins to the Block N Load Arenas along with an overhauled progression system to go with it.


Other highlights include:
•	Separate Ranked Beta mode.
•	New Hero progression rewards.
•	Changes to Roly and Tony's weapons.

[h1]Casual and Ranked Beta[/h1]
Previously all players in Block N Load were entered in to one mode “Classic” which mixed together players who wanted a heavily competitive experience, and those who wanted to play without quite so much pressure. We’ve split Classic into two modes, both of which have their own set of rules, which we'll experiment with over the course of the Beta. We'll keep you posted as to any changes as we go.

Ranked will only be available at weekends initially. Check out the Play Screen Game Mode selector for dates and times in your region.

[h1]Gold Bar Rewards[/h1]
Gold Bars awards now take in to account the length of the match, up to a cap.

[h1]Progression[/h1]

[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2.7Updateapril2016_680X284.png]

We’ve made some quite significant changes to the Hero progression systems. Block Skins are back and you can get them by leveling up your heroes to 10 and 50 where you'll unlock block skins that can be used by any Hero that can take that Block into battle. We've also added more badges and titles for you to earn. 

[h1]Heroes[/h1]
[b]Roly Poly Fat Fat[/b]
Roly’s Booster system (her secondary weapon) and Hero Block have both had some significant changes made to them.

[u]Booster Vent[/u]
Roly's secondary weapon's alt-fire now creates puddles of bubbling Toxic Goo trailing behind her. Use it to deny enemy access or help an escape.

[u]Toxic Waste[/u]
When Roly’s Hero Block is detonated it too will coat the area around it with splodges of seething Toxic Goo.

[u]Toxic Goo[/u]
Friendly goo is blue, while pink enemy Goo poisons and slows foes. Toxic Goo doesn’t hang around forever though - as enemy Heroes pass through it the Toxic Goo will be slowly used up, and eventually destroyed.

[b]Tony Turretto[/b]
The way the shots from the Rivet Gun scatter has been changed.  Previously the pellets from the Rivet Gun would form tight clusters.  This often meant that you would either hit with all the pellets or you would miss all of them.  The pellets from the Rivet Gun now scatter more randomly within its cone of fire.

[b]Additional Improvements and Fixes[/b]
We’ve also been fixing some bugs and improving other areas of the game.

Check out the [url=https://www.blocknload.com/article/update-notes-2-7/]Full Patch Notes[/url] for every little detail!

P.S., if you managed to qualify for Bronze league in our previous league system, you'll have a sweet Sweet Science Promo skin waiting for you. And because clothes really do maketh the man, Sweet Science, the man himself, is on sale for 50% off the Platinum price until Monday, 5pm BST.

notes.title: The Road to Ranked
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Steam_announce_edit.jpg[/img]

As we’ve mentioned in our Roadmap, we are working on separating Classic into two modes: Casual and Ranked. The reason for this is simple.

Combining competitive players who want to fight for a spot on the leaderboard and casual players who just want to have fun was causing conflict. We want to ensure that new players have a fair chance to learn and enjoy the game while veteran and experienced players are able to compete with other players in a fair fight.

To do this we have created a new Ranked mode that will be released initially as a Beta so that we can experiment with squad sizes and rulesets. As always, we think this will spark some questions we've tried to anticipate.

[h1]When will the Ranked Beta go live?[/h1]
We’re currently teasing out some bugs with the new mode (and we have an exciting new progression system to release as well!), so we don’t want to put an exact date on it, but we hope to go live within the next couple of weeks.

[h1]Is the playerbase big enough to support two modes?[/h1]
Not yet, but we’re hoping to grow it! Initially, Ranked will be available at limited times in North America and EU regions only.

[h1]What times and in which regions will the Ranked Beta be available?[/h1]
In the EU and NA regions, Ranked will be available at weekends only and exact times are still to be decided.

[h1]Will the queue times for Ranked be really long?[/h1]
They might be! This is why we're running a Beta pre-season. We’re going to experiment with various squad size and queuing options to see what works best, but it’s possible that players in the Ranked queue might need to wait a bit to get a match.

[h1]What are the new rules for Ranked?[/h1]
We’re still working through those and we’d like you to help! Hop on over to our Ranked Rules survey and tell us what you think the rules should be!

[h1]What about Leaderboards?[/h1]
These will work largely as they do now, with some tweaks as we go.

[h1]What about my current league rank? Will I get to keep it?[/h1]
Everyone playing Ranked will be starting fresh. Matchmaking ratings and your tiers will all be reset. As a special bonus, however, we’ll be giving all players who have achieved any rank in our current league system an exclusive Sweet Science Hero skin. You have until the 21st of April to get to Bronze if you haven’t yet, so get playing now! Your hero skin will be delivered when we launch our Ranked mode!

[h1]Where can we give you feedback on these plans?[/h1]
Glad you asked! We're running a poll with a few questions we'd like your input on. 

[url=https://www.surveymonkey.co.uk/r/bnl-ranked-arenas]Head on over and fill in our Ranked survey now![/url]

notes.title: Balancing Update 2.6.2
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/steam_announcement_26-2.png[/img]

The next series of balancing changes has just arrived in Block N Load after feedback from players.  In addition to this, we’re also introducing a number of changes to arenas & refreshing the rotation!

The changes to the World Blocks, which make up the majority of most of our arenas, are some of the most wide-reaching that we’ve made in a balancing pass to date.  With these Blocks making up such a large part of the areas that the matches take place in even a small change can have a large impact.  With these changes you should find that it’s now easier to tunnel through some materials than others, and that damage from weapons affects the  Blocks that we’ve changed in different ways depending on the power of the weapon.

We’ve also tried to address some of the more common comments about balancing that we’ve seen – such as the timer on Astarella’s Orbital Strike Beacon Hero Block being too short to be able to reach it and defuse it – whilst making other changes around this to keep the blocks as balanced as possible when compared against each other.

[url=https://www.blocknload.com/article/update-notes-version-2-6-2/]For the full patch notes click here.[/url]

_________________________________________________

[h1]Current Free Hero Rotation:[/h1]

Yury, Nigel & Dream Genie


[h1]Current Time Assault Arena:[/h1]

Metal Monstrosity [Cogwheel]

notes.title: Community Tournament
notes.content:
[IMG]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/steam_announcement.png[/IMG]

Attention all Block n Load lovers! Following the awesome community hosted Winter Invitational, get ready for the GS Invitational! Genesis will be hosting a tournament starting April 1 and ending April 30. Come and watch your favorite BnL players from North America and Oceania team up and compete for bragging rights. 


[h1]April 1st - Registration Deadline[/h1]
[i]All teams must register; Brackets & Schedules will be posted April 3[/i]

[h1]April 9th - Week One[/h1]
[i]The "Big 4" teams meet for the first time; Challenger Brackets[/i]

[h1]April 16th - Week Two[/h1]
[i]Last week of Challenger; surviving "Big 3" face off[/i]

[h1]April 23rd - Week 3: Semi-Finals[/h1]
[i]Challenger Bracket winner faces second-ranked "Big 2;" Top on bye[/i]

[h1]April 30th - Week 4: Finals[/h1]
[i]For all the bragging rights; Semi-Finals winner against the "Big 1"[/i]


[b]Prize Pool[/b]

The two teams in the FINALS will SPLIT a crowdfunded prize pool provided by the Block n Load fans!

For full details, to register a team, where to watch each game and to keep up to date with tournament progress, via [url=https://www.blocknload.com/article/tournament-gs-invitational/]this link.[/url]

________________________________________

[h1]In other News[/h1]

[b]Free Rotation[/b]

Today Dream Genie has stepped out of the lamp to join Sarge & Nigel  in free rotation

[b]Dream Genie[/b]

Dream Genie's Conjuration allows her to build from long range, support your allies from afar or rain down bombs on your enemies. Sprint into your enemy's base and use your active ability, Jinx to confuse any nearby enemy blocks turning it against them for a few seconds.

[url=https://www.blocknload.com/hero/dream-genie/]Click here for full details[/url]

[b]Time Assault[/b]

This week has seen the return of Sweet Science's Luftschloss Time Assault Arena!

[IMG]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/luftschloss_screenie.png[/img]

Set your best time, compete on the leaderboard, and win yourself bonus Gold.

notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/steam_announce_2.6.jpg[/img]

We’ve received a lot of feedback about the Heroes in Block N Load, which ones are difficult to play, and which ones are easier to control the battlefield with.  As a result of this feedback we’ve made a number of balancing changes to a selection of Blocks, some Heroes, and also a few more Perks.

For the full list of what’s changed, check out the [url=https://www.blocknload.com/article/update-2-6-1/]full patch notes[/url].

As always, let us know what you think!

notes.title: Update 2.5 - Kreepy the Klown
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/steam-promo.jpg[/img]

Update 2.5 brings a new Hero to Block N Load as well as a whole host of improvements and changes.  

[h1]KREEPY THE KLOWN[/h1]

Now available for all birthday parties and evil rituals, it’s Kreepy the Klown – Block N Load’s scariest Hero. This malevolent mischief-maker is now available to buy via the in-game shop. 

Kreepy comes armed to the teeth with boxing-glove Extendo Arms, explosive Trick Bananas and the most terrifying Hero Block to be added to the game to date.

Like every Hero, Kreepy also has some uniquely killer abilities. His giant Klown Shoes give him unnaturally high jumping skills and his active ability traps nearby enemies in a frightening maze of psychological spookiness (think Nigel’s Tiki Heads but with more evil clowns). From his dungarees to his fangs, Kreepy is 100% terrifying and 100% awesome.

If Kreepy sounds like the gig for you, head over to the in-game store and start spooking your opponents. Are you ready to give your foes nightmares?

Get him now!

> [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=609721834]Introductory Hero Guide[/url] <

[h1]ARENAS[/h1]
Sandy Shores has three objectives to take down in order to secure the victory. With wooden walkways, towers, mountains, and sandy beaches to scramble over when launching assaults, there are plenty routes to find and opportunities for forging your own path.

Beach Base has had a significant re-design to improve movement around the arena and allow for new attack routes, particularly when attempting to flank across the middle of the arena.

Additionally, all of the Arenas have been updated to accommodate multiple points for the BlockBuster Boost to appear at.  The BlockBuster Boost can now come in at any of these locations like Supply Drops.  This should allow more opportunities for different tactics for teams preparing for the BlockBuster Boost to drop in.

[h1]SUPPLY DROPS[/h1]
Supply Drops are now twice as frequent as they were before, however, each individual Supply Drop is worth half of the value it previously had.  This means that you will have more opportunities to grab resources for your team.

[h1]BRICK WALLET CAP[/h1]
The number of Bricks anyone can have as resources for building can now never exceed 5,000 at any time. 

During a match, the number of Bricks that your Hero currently has is displayed in the lower left.  Once 5,000 has been reached this number will begin to pulse red and you will be unable to gather more resources until you have spent some on building Blocks.

[h1]MORE CHANGES[/h1]
Want to read more about the other changes that are in this update?  [url=https://www.blocknload.com/article/update-notes-version-2-5/]Check out the full update notes,[/url] and give us your thoughts on the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forums![/url]

[b]The Block N Load Team[/b]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Current Free Rotation[/b]: 
[list][*]Sarge Stone
[*]Nigel Purdey-Longshot
[*]Dream Genie[/list]
[b]Current Time Assault Hero[/b]: Cogwheel

notes.title: Dev Blog #1 is Live!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/Steam_Announcement_devblog_616x353.png[/IMG]

Introducing our first in a series of Dev Stats blogs - available now  [url=https://www.blocknload.com/article/dev-blog-1/]on our website.[/url]

Why do we want to share this with you?

We want you to be involved more than ever in the development of new features, and in our Hero balance activities. We’ll let you know how this will work over the next couple of weeks, but we’re really excited about getting your input and making the game truly player-driven. 

We’ve kicked this off with a new build on our PTR (Player Test Realm) server. We’ve got some pretty important gameplay changes, automatic cheat-detection solutions, and (most excitingly) a new Hero to play test! 

[h1]Sound awesome, how do I become a tester and get involved?[/h1]
[olist][*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/11/458605613388682597/]Access the Player Test Realm[/url]

[*][url=steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/11/]Give feedback to help shape the game[/url]

[*][url=https://www.surveymonkey.co.uk/r/ptr-balancing]Take the survey[/url][/olist]

We aim to gather initial feedback & survey results on Monday, after which we will start experimenting with balance improvements.

As always, thank you for your enthusiasm and involvement!

The Block N Load Team

notes.title: Roly Poly's Festive Mission - Unlock an Exclusive Hero Skin!
notes.content:

[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/NomNom_steam-promo.jpg[/img]

Update 2.4 brings map mania to Block N Load. Top of the pile is the Map Editor which puts you in the seat of level designer. The update also brings a set of 4 fantastic new maps for classic mode, as well as a brand new Time Assault map themed around Sir Nigel Purdey-Longshott.

[h1]MAP EDITOR[/h1]
Work hard, play even harder with the Block N Load Map Editor. This brand new feature puts you in the seat of level designer. Create fully playable Block N Load arenas and invite the community to try them.
[list][*]Experiment with tonnes of block and terrain types.
[*]Build giant structures that can be battled over or admired.
[*]Learn how to make a competitive map by strategically placing objectives like Cubes and Bases.
[*]Set the mood with colour, texture and lighting options.
[*]Share your creation via Steam Workshop and invite people to play it. Who knows, your map could be the next big thing.[/list]
Think you can construct a classic? Prove it with the Block N Load Map Editor.

[*]Up ‘N Over – a beginner-focussed arena with a large central bridge.
[*]Search and Destroy –  another beginner-focussed arena with a fast-and-furious middle ground.[/list]

notes.title: Update - 2.3
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/steam-promo.jpg[/img]

Update 2.3 is out NOW and brings big changes. A brand new single-player challenge mode is now live, called TIME ASSAULT. There are also big changes to the way bases take damage, and we’ve added profile stats data into the game!

[h1]SINGLE PLAYER MODE: TIME ASSAULT[/h1]

Are you quick enough for Time Assault challenge mode? The goal is simple - get your Hero from one side of the map to the other. The faster you go, the better your score and reward. There are no rules - just get there any way you can. We can’t wait to see how you get there – so get recording and streaming and send us the links.

[h1]Base Damage Changes[/h1]

We’ve changed the way the base cubes take damage! The ONLY WAY to damage a base now is with your melee (digging) tool. Weapons, bombs, rockets, grenades – they won’t work anymore. Cubes are now more fragile and a rechargeable shield has been introduced. A few melee hits on the shield will disable it, letting you chip away at the cube’s health. 

[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/Cube.gif]

You can read the full details this update brings [url=www.blocknload.com/article/update-notes-version-2-3/]on the website[/url] and give us your thoughts on the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forums![/url]

The Block N Load Team

notes.title: Free Hero Rotation - Vander Graaf
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/steam-promo_VanDerGraaf.jpg[/img]
In a blaze of lightning (and loud disco music) Vander Graaf deposes Tony Turretto to become your latest free-to-try hero. This funky fan of the fuse box is arguably the most complex character introduced to the free rotation to date.

Play him while you can - are you up for the challenge?

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rgNSphY.gif[/img] 

[h1]Electric Overview[/h1]
Vander Graaf is an electric warrior of the highest order. When he’s not charging up his Static Gloves with his suspiciously good moonwalking skills, he can usually be found weaving wicked webs of Tesla Coil blocks. He is a Brains character and is best played in a cautious and devious manner. You’ll need a good understanding of enemy attack routes to be able to lay his traps.

[h1]5 Bullets for Bossing Vander Graaf[/h1]

1. Trap your enemies by building a field of unique Tesla Coil blocks. They conduct the lightning fired by Vander’s weapons. This allows you to hit enemies from a concealed location, trapping them in a deadly web of electro doom!

2. The high-voltage hero gets his power from the static generated by his boots. Sprint around the battlefield to create more static and add more ammunition to Vander’s Static Gloves.

3. With Vander, offence is also defence. Utilise the Lightning Cage active skill to surround Vander (and nearby any allies) in a protective field of electricity that also harms opponents. Switch this on for stress-free attacks on the enemy cube.

4. Vander’s class specific load out includes Radar – hide these bad boys from your enemies to light them up on the minimap and stay ahead of the game.

5. Charge up Vander’s secondary weapon – Ball Lightning – for a quick and powerful blast directly in front of you.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Free Rotation - Update
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/kira_in_rotation_steam_promo.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sayonara, Nigel. Konnichiwa, Kira-chan.[/h1]

Ladies and Gentleman, please welcome to the stage, Kira-Chan. This J-Pop assassin is all about the full frontal assault and you have a backstage pass to try her out for free.

Replacing Nigel in the free hero rotation* would be a tough act to follow for some, but Kira is a pro. Ready yourself for twin, custom SMGs, the Kitty Cannon, and a monstrous skill set that lets her buff the speed of allies reload and shield-up with every enemy she downs, kawaii!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ACuE7Y5.gif[/img]

Kira is the star of the show – and she wants everyone to know it so here are the 5 Bullets for Bossing Kira-Chan:

[h1]5 BULLETS FOR BOSSING KIRA-CHAN[/h1]
1. Deploy Speed and Bounce Pads to hurl Kira-Chan into your enemy. The quicker, the better – Kira loves shock tactics
2. Mow foes down with the fully-automatic alt-fire on her standard weapons – the twin SMGs Hidari and Migi.
3. Utilise the two firing modes of her Kitty Cannon to litter the battlefield with deadly rocket and grenade kitties.
4. Build two of her unique Popstar Portals to warp across the map – but beware, the enemy can use them too.
5. Activate her J-Pop Star skill to turn the battlefield into a music video. This gives Kira unlimited ammo for its duration and nearby allies reload faster.

For a more detailed look at Kira-Chan check out her [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TF32COULC90]promotional video[/url] – fully endorsed by her agent.

[h1]*WAIT A SECOND, WHERE’S NIGEL GONE!?![/h1] 
Fret not, Longshott! Nigel is only taking a  nap by the fire.

If you liked the playstyle of  this big-game  hunter and want to snipe him  for yourself,  he’s still available to purchase via the in  game store.

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[h1]Yuri the Yeti[/h1]
The cooldown for the “Avalanche” Active Ability has been reduced meaning it can be used more frequently.
[list][*]From 100 to 90 seconds at level 0
[*]From 90 to 60 seconds at levels 1 and 2
[*]From 80 to 50 seconds at levels 3 and 4
[*]From 70 to 40 seconds at levels 7 and 8
[*]From 60 to 30 seconds at levels 9 and 10[/list]
[h1]O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi[/h1]
The amount of healing granted by use of the “Vanish” Active Ability has been reduced.
[list][*]From 25% to 20% of O.P.’s standard health at levels 0 to 3. 
[*]From 50% to 40% of O.P.’s standard health at levels 4 to 6.
[*]From 75% to 60% of O.P.’s standard health at levels 7 to 9.
[*]From 100% to 80% of O.P.’s standard health at level 10.[/list]
The standard number of Ninja Stars that O.P. can carry has been reduced from 48 to 24.

If you want to discuss this and more, head on over to our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url]

notes.title: Update - Build 2.2.1267
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/steam-promo_Roly.jpg[/img]

Hey all,

Below are the main highlights of today's update.

[h1]Roly Poly Fat Fat[/h1] 
This update brings a new Hero to Block N Load: Roly Poly Fat Fat!

The world’s cutest hamster. The world’s deadliest hamster ball. Roly Poly Fat Fat blasts onto the battlefield with her TankBall Cannons, Boosters, and Toxic Waste. Fully weaponised, she’s ready to roll. 

If you want to know more about Roly Poly Fat Fat, her weapons, abilities, and Blocks click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/496880503062204498/]here[/url].

[h1]Perks[/h1] 
We have just completed a review of all the perks in Block N Load and as a result our perks system has undergone a major re-balancing to make some pretty significant improvements.

The overall goal of the perks was to allow additional options in how Heroes are played through combining perks with Heroes and your personal play styles.  We also wanted to make sure that as you progress through tier 1, 2 and 3 of each perk they were clearly improvements in your specialization.  To this end we have decided to implement a flat negative for all tiers of a particular perk.  

This means it is clearly better to continue down the line of the perk and invest in higher levels, in all instances of use.  This has been done for all Offensive, Defensive and Hero Perks.

We have also normalized a lot of the numbers and done a balance pass on some of the perks to now take account of this new flat negative value.

[h1]Balancing Changes[/h1]
A whole host of other balancing changes have been made including:

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 2.1.1210 (15/10/2015)
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/steam-promo_demo.jpg[/img]
Hey all,

Below are the main highlights for the latest Block N Load update.

[h1]Free Rotation[/h1]
[list][*] Sarge Stone is being removed from the Free Rotation and replaced with Cogwheel, our stomping heavy metal robot.[/list]
[h1]Heroes[/h1]
[i]We saw on the forums that some players thought the “Bloody Bleeding” Hero Perk was a touch on the powerful side.  We looked both at the kill rates, and the overall damage that it added, and we have now brought it more in line with the other Hero Perks.

We also noticed that even in newer players hands O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi (and to a lesser extent Sweet Science) were getting hit and damage rates higher than other Heroes in similar level of skilled players.  Looking at the data we realized that their current swing “arc” was way too generous and players could basically just spam the attack button and even if only an elbow of the enemy was in screen it would “hit”.  The reduction of the arc will have absolutely no impact on most players, but the “just attack all the time, don't worry you will hit” aspect is now reduced.

For the specific numbers and information on these changes please see the sections for O.P. and Sweet Science below.[/i].

[b]O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi[/b]
[list][*] Effects of the “Bloody Bleeding” Hero Perk have been slightly reduced.  The DPS inflicted by the Bleed effect when the Perk is equipped has been changed from 4 at level 1, 4.5 at level 2, and 5 at level 3 to 3.5 at level 1, 4 at level 2, and 4.5 at level 3.  The Bleed effect remains at 5 seconds in length.  
[*] The description of the “Bloody Bleeding” Hero Perk has been changed to make the effects clearer.
[*] Arc of the Katana has been reduced from 60 degrees to 45 degrees.  This means it will no longer hit targets on the edges of the screen.[/list]
[b]Sweet Science[/b]
[list][*] Arc of the Blitz Stance attack has been reduced from 60 degrees to 45 degrees.  This means it will no longer hit targets on the edges of the screen.[/list]
[b]Sarge Stone[/b]
[list][*] The “Just a Scratch” Hero Perk no longer affects the rate at which Sarge's Passive Ability heals him and now only affects the maximum HP that his Passive Ability can heal up to.[/list]
[b]Vander Graaf[/b]
[*] Out of ammunition audio will no longer trigger when switching to Ball Lightning with a partially filled clip and ammo pool.[/list]
[b]Astarella[/b]
[list][*] The Sonic Drill tool no longer points sideways when the Hero is moving sideways with it equipped.[/list]
[h1]General Perks[/h1]
[list][*] The description of the “Dig that Health” Defensive Perk has been changed to better explain the effects.
[*] The description of the “Dig that Ammo” Offensive Perk has been changed to better explain the effects.
[*] The “Greedy” Defensive Perk has had the amount of extra bricks earned from 12% at level 2 and 15% at level 3 to 15% at level 2 and 20% at level 3.  The longer build times have also been changed from 12% at level 2 and 15% at level 3 to 15% at level 2 and 20% at level 3.
[*] The “Killer Bricks” Defensive Perk has had the extra bricks for killing a Hero changed from 25% at level 2 and 30% at level 3 to 30% at level 2 and 40% at level 3.  The longer build times have also been changed from 12% at level 2 and 15% at level 3 to 15% at level 2 and 20% at level 3.
[*] The name of the “Quick Fingers” Offensive Perk is now correctly capitalized.[/list]
[h1]Menus[/h1]
[b]Play[/b]
[list][*] A "First Win of the Day" bonus has been added. For the first match you win each day you will receive 100 extra Gold and, if you are in Bronze League or above, double the amount of League Points.
[*] The claxon sound effect when a match is found has been re-added to the pop-up for joining a match through short handed games.[/list]
[b]Profile[/b]
[list][*] The last Hero in the "Your Heroes" tab is no longer partially hidden behind the “Buy More Heroes” button.
[*] When viewing a level 0 Hero in the “Your Heroes” tab the XP to reach level 1 is now correctly displayed.
[*] The "Blocks Built" section should now correctly update.
[*] Matches which were joined using the “Join Shorthanded Games” backfilling system should now be displayed as a neutral result in the “Match History” tab.[/list]
[b]Shop[/b]
[list][*] Prices for the Featured Hero are now displayed in the correct order. 
[*] Hero Perks can now be viewed even if you do not own the Hero for them.
[*] The icon for Gold is now correctly greyed out on items when you do not have enough Gold for.
[*] The next level of a Perk becomes visible automatically when the previous level of it has been purchased.
[*] Clicking on a second weapon or ability in the "About" section of a Hero's information will now correctly de-select the first one that had been selected.
[*] When viewing skins for Heroes the button to purchase the Hero themselves will no longer be present under the preview image.  Heroes will only be available to purchase from the “Heroes” tab of the shop.[/list]
[b]Custom Game[/b]
[list][*] The menu for joining Custom Games has been rebuilt so that the last game in the list cannot become obscured behind the buttons.
[*] Game names can no longer have their size or colour changed.
[*] The preview of the Custom Game settings such as build time and respawn time now correctly updates for players browsing the list of games.
[*] The arrow buttons to change a map are no longer visible to players browsing the list of matches.
[*] The "Start Game" button no longer becomes hidden behind your player level if you have previously visited the Shop.
[*] An asterisk (*) is displayed after the name of a game which has already been started.
[*] The join game button is replaced with one stating the game has already been started if the match cannot be joined.[/list]
[b]Friends List[/b]
[list][*] Opening the Friends list when you have a large number of Block N Load or Steam friends no longer causes a significant pause.
[*] When removing a Block N Load friend from your friends list the confirmation message no longer stays open after confirming you wish to remove the friend.
[*] Friends who are online in Steam but not currently playing Block N Load should now be able to be invited to play again.[/list]
[b]Messaging[/b]
[list][*] The correct reward text should now be displayed on the end of game fanfare when you reach Gold League.
[*] The message displayed on the end of match fanfare when a player has completed the match after joining it to fill in for a player that dropped out no longer stretches over the edges of the screen.
[*] Messaging on the end of match fanfare for when a challenge is completed should no longer overlap the edge of the screen in any language.[/list]
[h1]Results Screen[/h1]
[list][*] Players are no longer incorrectly marked as offline when they leave the results screen at the end of a match.
[*]The number of blocks built and destroyed are now displayed on the end of match results screen.[/list]
[h1]HUD[/h1]
[list][*] Your own ping (latency) will now be displayed on the scoreboard if you activate it up during a match.
[*] Icons for your Hero’s current health and ammunition have been updated.
[*] The Hero tips displayed when playing with a low level Hero can now be seen when waiting to respawn as well.[/list]
[h1]League[/h1]
[list][*] Players no longer gain League Points for losing a match whilst in Bronze League.
[*] Players who reach Pro League should now have this correctly displayed on their player card.[/list]
You can read the full patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/490123197942125305/]here[/url]

The "Start Game" button no longer becomes hidden behind your player level if you have previously visited the Shop.
An asterisk (*) is displayed after the name of a game which has already been started.
The join game button is replaced with one stating the game has already been started if the match cannot be joined.
Opening the Friends list when you have a large number of Block N Load or Steam friends no longer causes a significant pause.
When removing a Block N Load friend from your friends list the confirmation message no longer stays open after confirming you wish to remove the friend.
Friends who are online in Steam but not currently playing Block N Load should now be able to be invited to play again.
The correct reward text should now be displayed on the end of game fanfare when you reach Gold League.

Messaging on the end of match fanfare for when a challenge is completed should no longer overlap the edge of the screen in any language.
Players are no longer incorrectly marked as offline when they leave the results screen at the end of a match.
The number of blocks built and destroyed are now displayed on the end of match results screen.
Your own ping (latency) will now be displayed on the scoreboard if you activate it up during a match.
Players no longer gain League Points for losing a match whilst in Bronze League.
Vander Graaf[*] Out of ammunition audio will no longer trigger when switching to Ball Lightning with a partially filled clip and ammo pool.
Astarella[*] The Sonic Drill tool no longer points sideways when the Hero is moving sideways with it equipped.
The "Bloody Bleeding" Hero Perk was changed to make the effects clearer.
The "Dig that Health" Defensive Perk has been changed to better explain the effects.
The "Dig that Ammo" Offensive Perk has been changed to better explain the effects.
The name of the “Quick Fingers” Offensive Perk is now correctly capitalized.
The claxon sound effect when a match is found has been re-added to the pop-up for joining a match through short handed games.
Icons for your Hero’s current health and ammunition have been updated.
The Hero tips displayed when playing with a low level Hero can now be seen when waiting to respawn as well.
Players who reach Pro League should now have this correctly displayed on their player card.

notes.title: Block N Load Free to Play Info!
notes.content:
[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/steam-promo_demo.jpg][/img]


It’s been awhile since we have given new information and that’s because we have been very...very busy.  With what you may ask.  So hold on to your sandbags and miasma mines, we are going to give a ton of details below! 
 
Creating a Free to Play version of Block N Load is not something we were just going to “slap together” and in reality, we have touched nearly every single aspect of the game.  You will still find the Heroes and gameplay you love, but with huge enhancements to the game that add new strategies, customization and gameplay.  OK enough high level babble, some details below.
 
[b]TL:DR: We pretty much touched every part of the game, and this first area of focus we are looking for feedback on the new Heroes with a Player Test Realm going live later this week.  More of the below features will be brought online as the test server progresses.[/b]
 
What's new?...
 
[h1]Soft Currency[/h1]
[i]Gold Bars[/i]
 
We are introducing a new currency that is awarded for all sorts of things in the game.  This is our “soft currency”.  Play a match, level a hero, complete a challenge (more on that later), level your player level and you will get Gold Bars.  These are then spent on various things in the game.  Gold Bars can never be bought for real money and must be earned by playing.
 
[h1]Challenges[/h1]
[i]A good way to earn Gold Bars[/i]
 
Every day a player will get 3 challenges in the following categories:
[list][*]Single match challenge - something you can complete in a single match
[*]Multi match challenge - something that may take 2 or more matches to complete
[*]24 hour challenge- something that will take 3 or more matches to complete, and you can “overachieve” for even more reward.[/list]
Some of these will be quite simple, play as “X” role, or place “Y” worth of bricks in devices while others are more skill based and performance.  Each 24 hours any completed “slots” will be restocked with a new challenge, and a player can reject/pass on any 1 challenge once every 24 hours if they don’t want to attempt it and get a new one.
 
[h1]Perks[/h1]
[i]Customize and specialize your play[/i]
 
One of the major places you spend your Gold Bars is on perks.  There are 3 categories of perks
[list][*]Offensive
[*]Defensive
[*]Hero[/list]
Every perk has a bonus, and minor negative a Hero gains when they are equipped, in addition each Perk has 3 tiers to upgrade that increase in power for each level.
 
In the lobby you can equip 1 from each category for a total of 3 perks brought into a match (although you can own as many as you like).  Once you buy a Perk, it’s yours forever.  Offensive and Defensive Perks can be used on any Hero once you unlock them but Hero perks are specific and can be only equipped by that Hero.
Examples:
 
[b][i]Offensive Perk:[/i][/b]
Dig That Ammo - Gain “X” ammo when digging/Lose “Y” base Hero ammo pool
[list][*]L1= 2%/2%
[*]L2= 5%/5%
[*]L3= 10%/10%[/list]
[b][i]Defensive Perk:[/i][/b]
Walk It Off - Take “X”  less damage from splash damage and explosions/Movement speed is slower by “Y”
[list][*]L1= 10%/10%
[*]L2= 16%/12%
[*]L3= 20%/14%[/list]
[b][i]Hero Perk:[/i][/b]
Lil Buddy Boost - Turret health increased “X” and regenerates health slowly over time/ Turret does “Y” less damage
[list][*]L1= 35%/10%
[*]L2= 42%/15%
[*]L3= 50%/20%[/list]
There are 9 offensive Perks, 9 Defensive, and each Hero has 3 Perks that you can use to specialize/min max your play style.
 
We will be releasing more info (and complete lists) shortly.  We are still balancing everything so numbers [b]WILL[/b] change =)
 
[h1]Hero Leveling[/h1]
 
With stats being adjusted with perks, old Hero leveling has been redone completely.  You still level your active ability while leveling, but you will also receive soft currency rewards as you level your Hero.  Your Hero will be at “[i]full power[/i]” by level 10 and we have removed a lot of the “[i]power[/i]” from leveling itself, and in addition we have moved the cap to level 100.  If you want to play just sarge for a few hundred matches and earn soft currency, go crazy!
 
[h1]Player Leveling[/h1]
 
We are removing Player Score completely, and are implementing a proper Player XP curve.  You will earn soft currency at milestones as you level and there is [b]NO CAP[/b].
 
Your player score will be wiped (it does not exist anymore) and your Hero levels reset.  We thought long and hard over this, but because of the complete change of how leveling works, and we give you soft currency while progressing, it was “more” fair to reset it all. 
 
[h1]Matchmaking[/h1]
 
Behind the scenes we have fixed and adjusted a great deal with player matching and how MMR is dealing with teams.  We have also added an extra layer (invisible to players) that deals with new players specifically that will heavily bias them to play amongst themselves.
 
[h1]Single/Duo Queue[/h1]
 
We will be launching with players only being able to queue solo or duo.  We have seen in data that 5 man premade teams were facing players in pick up groups too often and thrashing them so we are addressing this.
 
5 man premade squads can still play and practice on Custom games, but not in the main queue.  As we increase CCU we will revisit this and increase it , or create a bespoke 5 man premade queue.
 
[h1]New Heroes[/h1]
 
What would a major update be without new Heroes?  We are adding 3 new Heroes to the lineup. Details to follow!
 
[h1]Player Test Server[/h1]
 
With so many changes and updates, we need to playtest a ton to get it balanced.  To this end we will be announcing a player test realm where many of these features will be available to play, test, and feedback on.  This should be live this week, and we are looking forward to your playing matches with you all.  We will also be setting up a forum for you to post on and we will be working very closely with any participants.  There will be a separate post about how to get into this server, as well as other details.
 
[h1]Store[/h1]
 
Content of the store, so what can I buy? 
 
Premium currency only:
[list][*]Hero Skins
[*]Block Skins
[*]XP doubler
[*]Gold doubler[/list]
Both Premium and Soft currency:
[list][*]Heroes[/list]
Soft Currency only:
[list][*]Perks[/list]
As you can see we are very firmly against pay to win.  If there is any power to be had, it can be totally earned by playing the game, and in some cases (perks) [b]ONLY[/b] by playing the game.  Details and specifics to come.
 
[h1]What happens to my stats/levels/attributes after the F2P relaunch?[/h1]
 
If you bought Block N Load before the F2P relaunch you will get:
[list][*]Tony
[*]Sarge
[*]OP
[*]Eliza
[*]Nigel
[*]Cog
[*]Sweet
[*]Astarella
[*]Genie[/list]
Plus all the skins you [b]COULD[/b] have unlocked, both block and Hero regardless if you did or not through play.  This does not include seasonal or promotional skins.  We will also be awarding a skin that [b]ONLY[/b] players who owned the game will receive in addition to this. 
 
[h1]Additional Features[/h1]
 
There are a few other features that will be coming online, maybe for launch, maybe shortly after, we are just sorting out the timing.  Some of them are really big deals, and we will release more info once we feel more comfortable.
 
As you can see there is a lot of new things going into the game and we are very excited to get the updated Block N Load in front of people and see what they think, to get it ready for launch and most importantly make it fun.  We are looking forward to seeing you online!
 
 
[b]Ben “Can8dnBen” Smedstad[/b]
[i]Creative/Design Director.[/i]

notes.title: Independence Weekend
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/steam-promo_4th_July.jpg[/img]

Party like it's 1776!

Celebrate Independence Weekend with our special map: E PLURIBUS UNUM 

This weekend heroes from around the world will be united in our common base-defending interests. In the words of Tony Turretto, “We will be fighting for our right to build. To tunnel. To skybridge. And should we win the day, the Fourth of July will be known as the day all heroes declare: “We will not leave our Cubes undefended! Today we celebrate Independence Weekend!”

Block in to Classic mode from 15:00 03/07/2015 to join the party through until 10:00 06/07/2015 and be sure to bring your own fireworks.

Balance changes have also just been pushed into the game, including changes to the Large Bomb, the BlockBuster and some of our heroes. 

[h1]Game Balancing[/h1]
[list][*]Sweet Science's Blitz Stance attack time increased to 0.25 (reduces rate of fire from 5 to 4attacks/sec)
[*]Eliza's Globe Gun attack time increased to 0.66 (reduces rate of fire from 2 to 1.5 attacks/sec)
[*]Large Bombs now have an incremental cost when more than one is built at the same time (each additional Large Bomb built after the first increases in cost by 600 bricks)
[*]Reduced the duration of all BlockBuster buffs from 120 to 90 sec
[*]Increased world and Player damage on Astarella's Orbital Beacon from 35 to 40
[*]Sweet Science and Dream Genie are now available to play in Ranked.[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 1.4 is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/steam-promo_dream_genie.jpg[/img]

Not only does this update unleash the Lady Of The Lamp, Update 1.4 also brings changes to recommended blocks, hero balance shifts, new arenas, matchmaking alterations, Blockbuster Boost and much more.

[h1]Heroes[/h1]
Now that we have fixed the issue which caused fire rates to be linked to frame rates, we have completed a pass on all Heroes bringing their damage up to where the “60 FPS” players were seeing it before the bug fix.  Heroes’ damage in relation to each other remains the same, but the overall damage-per-second average is up to 40 from 35 and so “seconds to death” has been slightly reduced for all Heroes to be in line with what was intended.

[h1]Dream Genie[/h1]
Another new Hero is entering the Block N Load arenas!  Dream Genie has some very unique options available to her including being throwing blocks that she constructs so that they are built further away from her and an active ability that can turn enemy devices to your team for a short period of time.  

See the Dream Genie guide [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=463198964]here[/url] for the full run down of her weapons and abilities.

[h1]Hero Balance[/h1]
[b]Astarella[/b]
[list][*] Recommended block loadout has been changed to Orbital Strike Beacon, Bricks, Glue, Bear Trap, Speed Block, and Bounce Pad.
[*] P.P.P. player and world damage has been increased from 5 to 6 per shot.
[*] Orbital Strike Beacon cost increase when placing multiple copies whilst one is still active has been reduced from 2000 to 1500 bricks.  
[*] Orbital Strike Beacon damage has been increased from 30 to 35. 
[*] Hit detection when aiming at Astarella’s stomach has been improved.
[*] The P.P.P. flashes when hitting another player are no longer as bright.
[*] A video on how to play Astarella has been added to her Learn page.[/list]

[b]Anthony ‘Tony’ Turretto[/b]
[list][*] Recommended block loadout has been changed to Lil’ Buddy, Bricks, Force Gate, Glue, Heal Station, and Ammo Crate.
[*] Rivet Gun accuracy has been increased and spread has been reduced.
[*] Lil’ Buddy turret HP has been increased from 120 to 150.
[*] Damage repaired by the Caulk Gun has been increased from 5 to 6.[/list]

[b]‘Doc’ Eliza Doolally[/b]
[list][*] Recommended block loadout has been changed to Miasma Mine, Fire Trap, Bricks, Large Bomb, Heal Station, and Ammo Crate.
[*] Globe Gun primary and alternate attack rate of fire has been increased from 1.5 to 2 shots per second.
[*] Miasma Mine gas damage reduced from 20 to 15 per second.
[*] Duration of gas clouds left when Eliza is killed or a level 10 Eliza uses their active ability has been reduced from 10 to 5 seconds.[/list]

[b]Sergeant ‘Sarge’ Stone[/b]
[list][*] M60 OMG rate of fire has been increased from 6.67 to 8 shots per second.[/list]

[b]Cogwheel[/b]
[list][*] Rotary Cannon primary and alternate attack rate of fire has been increased from 5 to 6.67 shots per second.[/list]

[b]Sweet Science[/b]
[list][*] Blitz Stance primary attack rate of fire has been increased from 4 to 5 punches per second.
[*] Blitz Stance animation has been improved to better represent where the blows from it will land.
[*] Position of Sweet Science’s hands when finishing walking and sprinting has been made more consistent. [/list]

[b]O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi[/b]
[list][*] The shape of the hands on the progression skin for O.P. when the tool is selected have been improved.[/list]

[h1]Arenas[/h1]
[list][*]Classic mode matches containing players new to Block N Load will have a slightly different selection of arenas available.  The existing arenas High and Low, Pillerd, and Insandity will be available along with the new arenas Citadel and Bulwark.
[*] Classic mode now includes the new arena Tower.
[*] Custom mode now includes the new arenas Tower, Citadel, and Bulwark as well as the existing arenas High and Low, Pillerd, and Insandity.
[*] Mount Olympus has been updated to include a metal plate under the Blockbuster drop location.[/list]

[h1]Hero Tips[/h1]
[list][*] When in a match as a level 1 or level 2 Hero a panel with hints and tips for the chosen Hero will be displayed in the upper left of the screen.  These can be minimized at any time, but will be maximized by default during the Build Phase and when in your team’s spawn area.[/list]

[h1]New Player Introduction[/h1]
[list][*] When new players enter in to the game they are now presented with options as to whether they wish to view a video tutorial, play the Practice Grounds tutorial arena, or skip the tutorials and go straight in to a queue for a Classic mode match.
[*] Where any match contains one or more players who have a player score of 10 or less the arena choice will be limited to Citadel, Bulwark, High and Low, Pillerd, and Insandity.  In these matches the XP and Player Score gained for completing the match is increased by 10% for all players.[/list]

[h1]Hero Selection[/h1]
[list][*] It is now no longer possible to select two of the same block with different skins in the loadout of a Hero.
[*] When selecting a Hero you will also be prompted to select whether you’re planning on attacking the enemy Base or defending your own so that the rest of your team can see what your plans for the match ahead are.  This does not affect Hero selection, or block availability, it just communicates your intention to your team mates.[/list]

[h1]Block Buster Boost[/h1]
[list][*] Duration of the boost has been increased from 90 to 120 seconds.
[*] Effects of the boost are no longer removed upon death, and players will have the effect for the full duration.
[*] Effects are applied to team-mates who were respawning at the time the boost was collected.
[*] A new version of the boost appears from 40 minutes after the end of the build phase.  This modifies damage to blocks and devices by 250% and incoming damage by 50%.[/list]

[h1]Matchmaking[/h1]
[list][*] The “Join shorthanded games” option to backfill in to games in progress is now switched off by default and is not available to players who are below Player Level 6.  It becomes available as an option after reaching Player Level 6.[/list]

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
[list][*] A new tutorial video has been added.  This can be accessed through the “Learn” section of the menu.
[*] The Practice Grounds tutorial has arena had some improvements made to it, including adding specific target blocks to the weapons section of the arena.
[*] The Radars placed in the tutorial now generate the debuff icon to indicate you have been spotted by them when you are near enough.
[*] The Fanfare screen displayed when selecting to leave the tutorial after collecting all the tokens, destroying the Base, or reaching the last room can now be skipped with keyboard presses as well as mouse buttons.[/list]

You can read our miscellaneous patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/598198356186854686/]here[/url]

notes.title: Game Update 1.3 is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/steam-promo2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ablockalypse Mode[/h1]
A new experimental mode named “Ablockalypse” has been added and will be available from 16:00 BST on Friday the 29th of May to 10:00 BST on Monday the 2nd of June.  Ablockalypse mode is crazy, fast, and great for new players or a short manic blast of fun for more experienced players.  It’s not meant to be balanced, it’s just meant to be crazy.  

Compared to the current other game modes:
[list][*] Damage to other Heroes is increased by 25%. 
[*] Damage to world and player placed blocks is increased by 100%.
[*] Build speed has been increased by 100% (decreasing the time taken to build Blocks).
[*] Costs of most blocks are reduced to half their normal values, with the exception of Crates, Sandbags, and Bricks which are free.
[*] The time to Recall to your main spawn point has been reduced to 5 seconds.
[*] Hero Switching is enabled regardless of player level.
[*] Cost of switching Heroes has been removed.
[*] Heroes' active ability cool-down times are reduced by 50%.
[*] The build phase length is set to 240 seconds (4 minutes).[/list]
Let us know what you think about Ablockalypse [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/618463106379331026/]here[/url]

[h1]Sweet Science[/h1]
The king of the ring has arrived.  Sweet Science is punch drunk, knockout happy, and he means business.  Dish out pounding blows with his fists, dash attack or pull enemy heroes towards him, set up gravity traps, disable enemy devices and heal yourself – when the bell rings Sweet Science will be coming at ya!  

For a full run down of Sweet Science check out our thread about him [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/618463106379334097/]here[/url]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list][*] Collision between Heroes has been improved to make them more polite and thus less likely to push each other to the sides (and more likely to stop when they collide).
[*] The mechanism for controlling the fire rate of weapons has been changed to make rates of fire more consistent.  This affected a number of weapon’s fire rates; the affected weapons have had to be re-balanced because of this.
[*] Blocks which are dropped on to Lava are now destroyed.
[*] Respawn times for Classic and Ranked matches have been updated.  These are now 15 seconds at the start of the match.  These then increase to 30 seconds from 15 minutes after the end of the build phase, 45 seconds from 30 minutes after the end of the build phase, and 60 seconds from 45 minutes after the end of build phase.[/list]
[h1]Heroes[/h1]
[b]Astarella[/b]
[list][*] P.P.P. attack time has been increased to 0.15 seconds to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations.
[*] Orbital Strike Beacon special block now has escalating costs.  The cost to build increases by 2000 Bricks for Orbital Strike Beacon you have placed which is still active.
[*] Orbital Strike Beacon special block has been increased from 27 to 30 per tick.[/list]

[b]Sergeant ‘Sarge’ Stone[/b]
[list][*] M60 OMG attack time has been increased to 0.15 seconds to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations.[/list]

[b]‘Doc’ Eliza Doolally[/b]
[list][*] Globe Gun primary and alternate fire attack times have been increased to 0.66 seconds to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations.
[*] Chem Grenade gas clouds now last for 5 seconds instead of 10 seconds.
[*] Miasma Mine special block gas clouds now last for 5 seconds instead of 10.
[*] Miasma Mine special block gas cloud damage has been increased from 15 per second to 20 per second. [/list]

[b]Cogwheel[/b]
[list][*] Rotary Cannon primary and alternate fire attack times have been increased to 0.2 seconds to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations.
[*] The textures for the tool and weapons on Cogwheel’s Dwarven Warsuit skin have been improved to better match his body.[/list]

[b]Anthony ‘Tony’ Turretto[/b]
[list][*] Tony’s Caulk Gun no longer applies the Tiki Head visual effect when a player runs through it. The “Slow” status effect is still applied.
[*] Rivet Gun damage has been reduced from 1.5 to 1.25 per pellet to compensate for the fix to fire rate calculations. 
[*]Lil’ Buddy turret special block have had their health increased from 100 to 120.[/list]

[b]O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi[/b]
[list][*] The bomb produced when using the “Vanish” active ability can now be hit and damaged.
[*] The smoke produced by the Katana alternate attack is now visible to the enemy team again.[/list]

[b]Blocks and Devices[/b]
[list][*] Glue Block no longer applies the Tiki Head visual effect when a player runs through it. The “Slow” status effect is still applied.[/list]
[h1]Performance[/h1]
[list][*] Fire Trap debris has been optimised so that it has a reduced effect on game performance.[/list]
[h1]Menus[/h1]
[list][*] Ablockalypse mode has been added to the list of options in the “Play” section.
[*] The Custom games option has been moved to the right in the “Play” section to accommodate the new Ablockalypse mode.
[*] The text describing the different game modes has been updated.
[*] Friendly mode has been re-named to “Classic”.
[*] The match history information displayed after searching for another player in the “Profile” section should now be correct.
[*] The icon to indicate you backfilled in to a game when looking at match history in the “Profile” section has had a hover-tip added.
[*] Players in the Graveyard will no longer be able to access Custom games.[/list]
[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
[list][*] The Practise Grounds tutorial have been completely re-designed to show off how to perform different game-play mechanics and to provide clearer instructions and ending.[/list]
[h1]Spectator[/h1]
[list][*] When using the Spectator mode to watch a Custom game the color of names in the kill feed should now correctly indicate which team they are on.[/list]
[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list][*] When hit by multiple sources of the “Slow” status effect the audio for these will no longer stack on top of each other.
[*] Additional sound effects have been added to the buttons when inviting players to squads.
[*] Buttons in the “Play” menu now only play one sound effect at a time. 
[*] The sound effects played when moving through water now respond to whether you are sprinting or walking.
[*] Additional sound effects have been added to Astarella and O.P.’s idle animations.
[*] Sound effects have been added when clicking on and releasing the sliders in the settings menus.
[*] Hero voice commands and death voice over lines should no longer play at the same time as the fanfare screen at the end of a Match.[/list]
[h1]Options[/h1]
[list][*] V-Sync is now switched off by default on all Master Graphics settings.[/list]
[h1]Arenas[/h1]
[list][*] The Last Bastion and Fun Factory have been added to Classic and Custom modes.
[*] Shuko Style and Beach Base have been added to Ranked mode.
[*] Insandity, High and Low, and Pillard have been added to Ablockalypse mode.
[*] A lava plane has been added to Mount Olympus, Olympia, Block Keep, Shuko Style, Pipe Mania, Causeway, Blockageddon, and A Cut Above.  This makes it clearer that falling off of the side of these arenas will kill your Hero.
[*] The no-build zones at the default spawn points have been improved in Beach Base, Pipe Mania, and Mount Olympia.
[*] Block Keep has had the position of the floating platforms tweaked slightly to improve their accessibility.[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 1.2 is Live!
notes.content:
[img=https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/steam-promo-astarella.jpg][/img]

Yesterday we released an update that added a new hero and changed some core areas of the game including Base health. It fundamentally changed the length of games too far, making them incredibly short, and we’ve read all your concerns and taken another look at how much we changed across the game. 

We’ve now implemented the below changes into this latest update and this will revert some areas to pre-patch levels. Check out the full details below.

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Cube and Base health has been restored to pre-update health.
[*]Respawn times have been updated. These now start at 10 seconds, becoming 15 seconds after 5 minutes, 30 seconds after 15 minutes, and then 45 seconds after 30 minutes.
[/list]
[b]Blocks[/b]
[list]
[*]Caltrops health and damage have been restored to their pre-update state.
[*]Orbital Strike Beacon damage to players and blocks has been reduced by 30% and we will review its mechanics in the short to medium term.
[/list]
[b]Blockbuster and Supply Drops[/b]
[list]
[*]Supply drops come in every 5 minutes after the end of the build phase unless there is a Blockbuster drop.
[*]Blockbuster drops come in at 15, 25, and 35 minutes and then every 5 minutes after that point.
[/list]
[b]Ranked Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Moving forward, we’ve decided that when bringing out any new hero they will not be immediately available in Ranked matches. This allows for final balance and testing with real players in other modes first. To this end Astarella has been removed from Ranked for a short period until we all are more happy with her.
[/list] 

......................................................................................................................................................

(14/05/2015)

Update 1.2 is here and it's packed full of content. In addition to Astarella, the first of our new heroes, and Ranked Mode, we've also added new arenas to the friendly rotation and made numerous balancing tweaks & fixes.

Leaving Beta we've found that matches are lasting significantly longer than they used to, and longer than intended.  As such a number of changes to balancing and gameplay mechanics have been made to address this.

Heroes have been given more control in the air.

We want Glue Blocks to be cool and worth taking as part of Heroes’ loadouts so we reworked them.

Similarly whilst Bear Traps worked pretty well they didn’t really feel like bear traps so they have been changed up a notch. 

All the heroes will take a little more time to breathe and consider what they say.

[url=https://www.blocknload.com/article/astarella-ranked-mode-are-here/]A record of full details for Update 1.2 can be found on our website[/url]

notes.title: IT'S TIME FOR THE FINAL BETA WEEKEND! (Build 868 is now live)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, who wants a Thursday surprise?

Our final BETA weekend is now OPEN FOR PLAY a day earlier than usual. 

Get into the game - we've updated our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/3/626329186792495300/]known issues[/url] thread and listed a few changes below. 

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[b]'Doc' Eliza Dolally:[/b][list]
[*]Miracle Cure (Active Ability) has been changed to now increase health over time. The amount of health it grants to Eliza and her nearby team-mates remains the same.
[*]Miracle Cure (Active Ability) has had its standard radius increased as well as the radius it affects after being upgraded at Hero level 4.
[*]Globe Gun (Primary Weapon) no longer causes critical hits.[/list]
[b]Sergeant 'Sarge' Stone:[/b][list]
[*]C4 (Special Block) now has a reduced timer before it detonates.[/list]
[b]Anthony 'Tony' Turretto:[/b]
[*]The standard and critical damage of his Rivet Gun (Primary Weapon) have both been slightly increased.[/list]

[h1]Fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[b]General[/b][list]
[*]An issue which caused the game to become stuck on a loading screen when re-connecting to a match has now been fixed.
[*]New videos have been added to each of the Heroes pages in the “Learn” section of the menu.[/list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b][list]
[*]Improvements have been made to the way that weapons auto-reload. In particular this should prevent an issue where repeatedly clicking whilst reloading Eliza’s Globe Gun caused the reload to fail.[/list]
[b]Visual:[/b][list]
[*]Improvements to the way that the names and health bars of devices (such as Lil’ Buddy turrets and Mortars) are displayed. This includes limiting the range at which these will displayed and better controlling the size of them.
[*]Names and health bars of Cubes and Bases should no-longer be as large when viewed after being killed and waiting to respawn.
[*]Firing Nigel’s revolver whilst part-way through an idle animation should no longer leave the revolver pointing backwards.[/list]
[b]Settings:[/b][list]
[*]Improvements to the support for several different resolutions and the way text is displayed.
[*]Further improvements to the support for non-English keyboards when assigning key bindings.[/list]
[b]Practice Grounds:[/b][list]
[*]The Practice Grounds have undergone a wide variety of improvements including a new Arena with a new layout, some new voice over lines, and newly re-worked tips.
[*]Collecting all of the Practice Tokens now provides the option to leave the Practice Grounds.
[*]Completing or selecting to quit the Practice Grounds now correctly returns you to the menu.[/list]
[b]Audio:[/b][list]
[*]New sounds for the Supply Drops have been added.[/list]

As always, we'll see you in game - let's make the most of this one last BETA weekend!
