notes.title: Playtest Weekend - Build 818
notes.content:
[Img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Beta_Phase_2_Steam_Promo.jpg[/img]

With massive improvements to optimization, lots of new fixes, and the very first Block N Load tutorial in this weekend's BETA test make sure you get in game from 4pm UTC+1 Friday 10th April and help us perfect the game ready for launch! Check out the full update notes below.

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
We've made loads of really great optimization and bug fixes in the hopes of getting more players in game. We would love to hear if people are still experiencing FPS drops or latency. We would also like people who were unable to play our last release to give it another go. Even better, we’d love to hear how the graphics settings are helping or hindering you getting the best performance, so please do get in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/]touch with us![/url]

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
The first iteration of a playable tutorial level for Block N Load has been added to the game!  For many players you may find that the first time you click on the “Play” button after launching this update you are automatically placed in to the tutorial. For those who aren’t automatically given the chance to test this out you can access it from the “How to Play” section of the “Learn” tab on the menus. 

We would love to hear your feedback on this tutorial as it's the first version we've put out live. However, if you are in the tutorial and you really want to skip it and get in to matches with your friends you can skip the tutorial after pressing the escape key.

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[b]Nigel Purdey-Longshott:[/b][list]
[*]Active Ability “Spot Prey” radius has been lowered.
[*]Active Ability “Spot Prey” has a shorter cooldown.
[*]Active Ability “Spot Prey” gets upgraded when Nigel reaches level 4 to have two charges, at level 7 to have 3 charges, and at level 10 to have 4 charges.
[*]Active Ability “Spot Prey” no longer instantly reloads Nigel’s weapons.
[*]Passive Ability has been changed to “Bounty” giving Nigel & his team bonus resources when he kills another Hero.[/list]
[b]O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi[/b][list]
[*]Active Ability “Vanish” now always heals some health and restocks some ammunition.
[*]Active Ability “Vanish” effect on health and ammunition is increased to 50% at level 4, 75% at level 7, and 100% at level 10.[/list]
[b]Anthony 'Tony' Turretto[/b][list]
[*]Active Ability “Better, Faster, Stronger” now always applies the buff to the damage of Lil’ Buddy turrets within the radius of the ability.
[*]Passive Ability has been changed to “Hard Hat” which reduces the damage taken by Tony whilst he is building.
[*]The secondary weapon “Caulk Gun” has gained the effect of buffing the damage of Lil’ Buddy turrets whilst they are under repair.
[*]The duration of the Active Ability “Better, Faster, Stronger” increases to 13 seconds at level 4, 15 seconds at level 7, and 20 seconds at level 10.[/list]
[b]Dream Genie[/b][list]
[*]Active Ability “Jinx” effect now continues to exist for 15 seconds (unless the eye is destroyed).
[*]Active Ability “Jinx”’s eye is upgraded to 130 HP at level 4, 160 HP at level 7, and 200 HP at level 10.[/list]
[h1]Fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[b]Gameplay[/b][list]
[*]The respawn timers for Custom Games have been fixed!  No more need to set the timer to +100% to have it match the times in Friendly games
[*]An issue which could cause Heroes to stop moving forwards when attempting to strafe at the same time as moving over a sloped block has been removed.
[*]Attempting to wedge your Hero into the barrier during the build phase should no longer result in catapulting yourself up in to the sky.
[*]A method of forcing a Respawn Pad through the build barrier has been prevented.
[*]O.P.’s active ability should now always replenish the correct number of smoke bombs for his katana.
[*]Sweet Science’s active ability now correctly disables enemy Radars.
[*]Sweet Science’s secondary weapon alternate fire ( has been improved to try and make the effect on other Heroes more consistent as they are pulled towards Sweet Science.
[*]Collision when moving over the edges of blocks has been improved.  This should prevent the heads of characters clipping in to the roof when in tunnels that have little drops or climbs in them.
[*]Crouching in mud no longer prevents you from standing back up again.
[*]Dream Genie’s progression skin for her Heal Station can now be destroyed with tools.
[*]Dream Genie’s unique Lamp block now drops instead of being destroyed if the blocks under it are removed.
[*]The laser strike from Astarella’s Orbital Strike Beacon unique block now correctly damages Respawn Pads.
[*]The saucers from Astarella’s Saucer Launcher secondary weapon are now correctly placed when firing them very close to a wall.
[*]Using a Heroes Active Ability whilst firing will now interrupt firing a weapon so that the ability is used. However, you will need to start firing again afterwards.
[*]Improvements to collision with some blocks to make it easier to move over them, for example Mines and Respawn Pads.
[*]Heroes who kill Cogwheel are no longer tagged as if they were on Radar.
[*]Bombs which are placed sideways or upside down on blocks which are then destroyed no longer fall through terrain.
[*]An issue which prevented Speed Pads from being placed next to each other has been fixed.
[*]Pressing the switch weapon key with the tool selected now returns you to the last weapon you had been using instead of the Hero’s primary weapon.[/list]
[b]Visual:[/b][list]
[*]Cogwheel now has a new model for the beacon he throws when using his active ability to fire his Mortars.
[*]The icons in the kill-feed for Tony’s Rivet Gun and Cogwheel’s Mortars have been improved to make them more representative of the weapon.
[*]Turning off the “Show Grass” option in the settings menu removes some of the long grass seen on the dirt blocks with grass on top.
[*]Turning on “Advanced Water” in the settings menu now adds a new reflective water effect.
[*]The backgrounds for the tabs on the right hand side of the Hero selection page are now correctly displayed when the skin selection tab is active.
[*]The cancel button on the “Exit Game” prompt is now visually consistent with other cancel buttons across Block N Load.
[*]Improvements to the way that Heroes and Blocks at the edge of a players draw distance are displayed.
[*]The silhouette of Nigel’s Tiki Head which is displayed when building will now correctly indicate the direction the device will face when it has been placed.
[*]When a Cube is destroyed it should no longer have a visible beam of light pointing up in to the sky.
[*]Heroes should no longer appear to be shooting weapons from their foreheads when you are watching them firing.
[*]Supply Drops and Blockbuster now have their own visual effect when they are descending to the battlefield.
[*]Astarella’s Sonic Drill tool should now always display correctly when first viewed after loading in to a match.
[*]Astarella has a new secondary skin which is unlocked when she reaches her maximum level.
[*]Dream Genie’s hands have been improved by changing their shape and moving them slightly further away from the center of the screen when playing as this Hero.
[*]The colors used on the end of match scene where the Base is exploding have been improved.  Additionally, the Base exploding now does damage to the world around it!
[*]Improvements to the Tiki Head effect to make it begin to fade out a little quicker.[/list]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/618458030680993756/]Click for additional notes[/url]

See you in game at the weekend!

notes.title: Phase 2 Playtest Weekend - Build 774
notes.content:
[Img]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Beta_Phase_2_Steam_Promo.jpg[/img]

Join our first BETA Phase 2 playtest weekend from 3pm GMT Friday March 27th. With new features and content to test don’t miss out, get in game and continue to give us your feedback. Check what we've added and changed in our patch notes below.

[h1]New Heroes[/h1]
We have three new heroes who are being introduced in this update. [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/618457398964213138/]Read more for details[/url][/b]

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[b]BlockBuster[/b]
[list][*]The Blockbuster is designed to help avoid stalemates in matches.
[*]Every 15 minutes after the build phase ends a Blockbuster will arrive.  
[*]Once the Blockbuster is present in the map it must be damaged and destroyed before it drops the boost.  This can then be picked up by either team.
[*]The Blockbuster boost provides a shielded effect for the team that picks it up and increases that team’s damage to Blocks and Devices.
[*]The first drop is the “Blockbuster Light”, the second drop is the “Blockbuster Classic”, and all drops after that will be the “Blockbuster Extreme”.  The power of the shielded effect and the added of damage to blocks increases with each version of the Blockbuster drop.
[*]The boost provided by Blockbuster only lasts until you die, or until 10 minutes have passed, whichever comes first.[/list]
[b]Player Score[/b]
[list][*]We’ve added another form of progression – a player score which will be viewable to everyone. Player score is a crude number with no upper limit that tracks your Block N Load career and is awarded for your performance in matches. In time, it will be used for certain unlocks and achievements.[/list]
[b]New Menu Design[/b]
[List][*]The main menus of the game have received a substantial re-design to make them easier to use.  This includes some alterations to the Play menu which should make it clearer how to invite friends to form a squad and enter in to a game together.
[*]The tutorial video will no longer automatically play on launching Block N Load or clicking on the "Play" button.  This can now only be accessed from the "How to Play" section of the "Learn" tab on the menu.
[*]A new checkbox for "Join shorthanded games" has been added to the "Play Now" menus.  More on this below! [/List]
[b]AFK Detection[/b]
[List][*]Players who remain in a match but do not take action for a significant amount of time will now be kicked from the match.  This will also result in the player’s merits being reduced. [/List]
[b]Quit Match[/b]
[List][*]On the mid-match menu (accessed by pressing the "Esc" key during a match) there is now a "Quit Match" option if you are playing in the Friendly mode.  This will allow you to leave a match voluntarily, however, you will lose some merits for doing so. [/List]
[b]Shorthanded Games[/b]
[List][*] With both the AFK Detection and the Quit Match button a new feature has been added which allows players to choose to join games in progress. If you leave this option checked when you queue, you may be placed into an in-progress game with vacant team spaces. Joining games that are in progress provides a boost to XP earned.[/List]
[b]Device Drop Mechanic[/b]
[List][*]Destroying the block under a device (such as a Bomb, Lil' Buddy Turret, or Mortar) will no longer cause the device to be destroyed.  Instead the device will drop down until it settles on a block under it.  However, if the device hits the bottom of the arena it will still be destroyed. [/List]
[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[List][*] Juan’s Katana alt-fire, the teleporting smoke bomb, has been changed and now has to be reloaded between each use; consequently you can no longer chain together smoke bomb use.
[*]Tony's Rivet Gun has received an overhaul and now fires far more projectiles.  However, each one does less damage individually and these are fired in a wider spread.  This should make hitting foes that are up close much easier.
[*]Sarge's level 2 progression unlock has been changed to a 10% increase in reload speed. 
[*]Sarge’s active ability has been changed so that when at level 4 and 10 he no longer throws 2 or 3 grenades together.  Instead these can now be thrown individually, with each individual grenade having a 15 second cooldown timer once thrown. 
[*]OP’s Katana critical hit damage has been slightly increased. 
[*]OP’s Ninja Star alt-fire damage has been slightly decreased. 
[*]The hit-points of Cubes and Bases have been reduced. 
[*]Respawn timers now work slightly differently.  At the start of the match the respawn timer is 15 seconds, this then increases by 15 seconds every 15 minutes with a maximum cap of 60 seconds.
[*]The value of salvaging a Radar device has been increased. [/List]
[h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[List][*] An issue where Sarge could be made to crawl at high speed whilst aiming down the sights has now been fixed.  Sarge no-longer crawls faster when aiming down the sights of his M60.
[*]Hero switching will be enabled for all accounts with a player level less than 10.
[*]You can now correctly climb over a 1 high block when sprinting up a slope towards that block.
[*]Tony's Lil' Buddy turrets should no-longer attempt to fire through the Cubes and Bases at foes on the other side of them.
[*]Switching weapons to one which has an empty clip should automatically start it reloading (if you have any ammunition left for the weapon!)
[*]The mechanism for calculating falling damage after OP uses the Katana's smoke-bomb teleport alternate-fire has been improved.  This should mean that OP takes less falling damage if his teleport hits terrain, or is close to the ground.  (If you fire it up in to the sky still expect to get hurt).
[*]Improvements to the way that players and devices health and names are displayed to avoid these showing through terrain when they should not.
[*]A rare situation where exceptionally long Friendly games were awarding too little XP has been corrected.
[*]Attempting to shoot up out of mud should now result in hitting the mud first and only once the mud block is destroyed shooting up and out of it.[/List]
[b]Key Bindings[/b]
[List][*]The options for crouch toggle and sprint toggle have been added back in to the key bindings menu.[/List]
[b]Visual[/b]
[List][*]The hallucinatory effect of Nigel’s Tiki Heads has been changed and taken up a notch.
[*] The Supply Drop is no longer parachuted in from a plane.  Instead it now descends on a beam of light, making it much easier to spot where its arrival point will be.
[*]Supply Drops no longer look like a wooden crate.  Instead they are now a cube of translucent blue boxes which spin and rotate.
[*]Sarge's head no longer rotates through his body when jumping.
[*]The puff of smoke seen when a projectile hits a block has been made slightly more visible.
[*]The minimap has had some improvement. The general clarity has been improved and the map now indicates a larger variety of terrain height. Additionally, you are now represented by a clear arrow rather than hero picture.[/List]
[b]Text[/b]
[List][*]Multiple minor changes and corrections to pop-up messages, buttons, and text on menus.
[*]The name of Cogwheel's Special Block has been changed to "Mortar".
[*]The description of several blocks (including the Mortar and Crate) have been improved on both the Hero Selection and Learn screens.
[*]The time taken to build a block visible on the Hero Selection screen when hovering over a block should now be correctly displayed.[/List]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/618456760283552537/][b]Click for miscellaneous notes[/b][/url]

As usual, you can let us know your thoughts below or on our Discussion Boards here on Steam. See you in game at the weekend!

On the mid-match menu (accessed by pressing the "Esc" key during a match) there is now a "Quit Match" option if you are playing in the Friendly mode. This will allow you to leave a match voluntarily, however, you will lose some merits for doing so.

With both the AFK Detection and the Quit Match button a new feature has been added which allows players to choose to join games in progress. If you leave this option checked when you queue, you may be placed into an in-progress game with vacant team spaces. Joining games that are in progress provides a boost to XP earned.

Destroying the block under a device (such as a Bomb, Lil' Buddy Turret, or Mortar) will no longer cause the device to be destroyed. Instead the device will drop down until it settles on a block under it. However, if the device hits the bottom of the arena it will still be destroyed.

tags.balance_change: Juan’s Katana alt-fire, the teleporting smoke bomb, has been changed and now has to be reloaded between each use; consequently you can no longer chain together smoke bomb use.

Tony's Rivet Gun has received an overhaul and now fires far more projectiles. However, each one does less damage individually and these are fired in a wider spread. This should make hitting foes that are up close much easier.
Sarge's level 2 progression unlock has been changed to a 10% increase in reload speed.

Sarge’s active ability has been changed so that when at level 4 and 10 he no longer throws 2 or 3 grenades together. Instead these can now be thrown individually, with each individual grenade having a 15 second cooldown timer once thrown.
OP’s Katana critical hit damage has been slightly increased.
OP’s Ninja Star alt-fire damage has been slightly decreased.
The hit-points of Cubes and Bases have been reduced.
Respawn timers now work slightly differently. At the start of the match the respawn timer is 15 seconds, this then increases by 15 seconds every 15 minutes with a maximum cap of 60 seconds.
The value of salvaging a Radar device has been increased.

tags.bug: An issue where Sarge could be made to crawl at high speed whilst aiming down the sights has now been fixed. Sarge no-longer crawls faster when aiming down the sights of his M60.

tags.feature: Hero switching will be enabled for all accounts with a player level less than 10.

tags.bug: You can now correctly climb over a 1 high block when sprinting up a slope towards that block.
Tony's Lil' Buddy turrets should no-longer attempt to fire through the Cubes and Bases at foes on the other side of them.
Switching weapons to one which has an empty clip should automatically start it reloading (if you have any ammunition left for the weapon!)

The mechanism for calculating falling damage after OP uses the Katana's smoke-bomb teleport alternate-fire has been improved. This should mean that OP takes less falling damage if his teleport hits terrain, or is close to the ground. (If you fire it up in to the sky still expect to get hurt).
Improvements to the way that players and devices health and names are displayed to avoid these showing through terrain when they should not.
A rare situation where exceptionally long Friendly games were awarding too little XP has been corrected.
Attempting to shoot up out of mud should now result in hitting the mud first and only once the mud block is destroyed shooting up and out of it.

tags.feature: The options for crouch toggle and sprint toggle have been added back in to the key bindings menu.
The hallucinatory effect of Nigel’s Tiki Heads has been changed and taken up a notch.
The Supply Drop is no longer parachuted in from a plane. Instead it now descends on a beam of light, making it much easier to spot where its arrival point will be.
Supply Drops no longer look like a wooden crate. Instead they are now a cube of translucent blue boxes which spin and rotate.

tags.bug: Sarge's head no longer rotates through his body when jumping.
The puff of smoke seen when a projectile hits a block has been made slightly more visible.

tags.feature: The minimap has had some improvement. The general clarity has been improved and the map now indicates a larger variety of terrain height. Additionally, you are now represented by a clear arrow rather than hero picture.

tags.bug: Multiple minor changes and corrections to pop-up messages, buttons, and text on menus.

tags.feature: The name of Cogwheel's Special Block has been changed to "Mortar".
The description of several blocks (including the Mortar and Crate) have been improved on both the Hero Selection and Learn screens.

tags.bug: The time taken to build a block visible on the Hero Selection screen when hovering over a block should now be correctly displayed.

notes.title: Build 703 - 12/02/2015
notes.content:
In addition to some awesome new features, such as hero switching and voice chat, this patch introduces some balancing alterations and numerous improvements and fixes to areas like the queuing system. Be sure to check out the full list of patch notes below.

[h1]Hero Switching[/h1]
Hero Switching is now enabled in Friendly matches by default, and Custom matches if the host of the match enables it. This allows you to choose a different hero when you have been killed. Be aware that switching your hero, or their block loadout, will destroy any blocks which you have placed which are not available to all heroes.

[h1]Voice Chat[/h1]
A preliminary version of voice chat is now present. You will only be heard in the Hero Select screen and in a match. Only your team will hear anything you say over voice chat. You can turn voice chat off completely in the settings menu if you do not wish to hear other players (Settings > Audio). This will stop you hearing anything other players are saying, and will stop you from being heard by other players.

[h1]Queuing[/h1]
[list][*]There is now a loud warning when a match has been found.
[*]If the Block N Load window does not have focus (either alt-tabbed out or minimized) when a match is found the icon in the taskbar will light up.
[*]There is no longer an option to decline a match when it has been found. [*]Players either have to accept, or will time-out.
[*]The second time a player fails to accept a match they will receive a warning message.
[*]Players who fail to join matches 3 or more times will be blocked from queuing for a short period of time. Continuing to fail to accept matches will result in a longer block on queuing.
[*]Players who fail to accept the prompt to join a match must confirm the message which appears on their screen before they can re-queue.[/list]
[h1]Sound[/h1]
[list][*]Improvements to voice over frequency and variety.
[*]Cap’n Cog from the Skins for the Win pack will now play voice over lines on the Hero Select screen.
[*]A preliminary version of voice chat is now present. You will only be heard in the Hero Select screen and in a match. Only your team will hear anything you say over voice chat. You can turn voice chat off completely in the settings menu if you do not wish to hear other players (Settings > Audio). [*]This will stop you hearing anything other players are saying, and will stop you from being heard by other players.[/list]
[h1]Settings/Options[/h1]
[list][*]When attempting to bind a key which is already assigned elsewhere to another function a warning prompt will appear.
[*]Audio menu contains an option to turn voice chat on and off named “Steam Voice”
[*]Audio menu contains an option to change the voice recording settings between “Off”, “Push To Talk” and “On”. When set to “Off” no voice will be transmitted from your microphone, on “Push To Talk” you will only be heard when holding the assigned key, and when set to “On” your microphone will always transmit to your team.
[*]Key binding option for push to talk voice chat has been added to the “Controls” menu under “Steam Voice in mode push to talk”.[/list]
[h1]Visual[/h1]
[list][*]The unlockable Shoji Speed Block skin now has a yellow arrow instead of red.
[*]Caltrops and Bear Traps are now team coloured.
[*]Joint between the unlockable Golden Cog skin’s tool and his arm has been improved.
[*]We have made where you need to click on the respawn select screen (after your hero has died) clearer.
[*]The barrier present during the build phase has been made more opaque.
[*]The muzzle flash from Eliza’s Acid Washer tool has received a further reduction in brightness.
[*]There is now a visual effect to Nigel’s passive ability, Speed Loader, being activated.
[*]Small improvements to end-game screens including the scoreboard.[/list]
[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[i]O.P. Juan Shinobi[/i]

As mentioned in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791436741025/announcements/detail/177099563870698536]Can8dnBen's post on balancing[/url] ​we felt that O.P. still needed a little tweaking, so we have made the following changes:
[list][*]Time taken to equip the Shuriken has been slightly increased.
[*]The time taken for the alternate-fire triple Shuriken attack has been increased.
[*]Katana can no longer perform critical hits.
[*]Katana damage lowered slightly.[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list][*]Sprockets and Lil’ Buddy turrets no longer take bleed damage.
[*]Stun effects are no longer applied to players under spawn protection.
[*]If a Ninja Shrine is blocked and O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi cannot teleport back to it when using his active ability the Ninja Shrine will be removed when the ability is used.
[*]Destroying a Lil’ Buddy turret with your tool will yield 100 bricks.
[*]Destroying a Sprocket with your tool will yield 100 bricks.
[*]Using the “Full Size Map” control now correctly displays a large version of the current Arena’s map in the center of the screen.
[*]Hero Switching is now enabled in Friendly matches by default, and Custom matches if the host of the match enables it. This allows you to choose a different hero when you have been killed. Be aware that switching anything about your hero, for example block load out, will destroy any blocks which you have placed which are not available to all heroes.
[*]The crosshairs for Al Castone’s Tommy Gun (Skins for the Win DLC) now better represents where the shots will land.
[*]When aiming at an enemy Hero with Tony’s Caulk Gun the “do not shoot” symbol is no longer displayed.
[*]Cap on the number of bricks gained from collapsing large structures (block cutting) has been reduced further.
[*]Hit detection has been improved for Cogwheel’s Cannon.
[*]Hit detection has been improved for Eliza’s Globe Gun.
[*]Hit detection has been improved for O.P.’s Katana.
[*]The toughness of ‘window’ blocks has been reduced making it easier for weapons to destroy glass windows.
[*]For devices with escalating costs, such as Lil’ Buddy turrets, the number displayed telling you how many you can build now takes into account the cost escalations.[/list]
[h1]Other/General[/h1]
[list][*]The reasons for reporting another player at the end of the match have been updated to better reflect the issues that have been reported to us.
Messaging related to losing merit has been improved.
[*]Chat message limits are now more strictly enforced to prevent exceptionally long messages from attempting to be sent.
[*]Some lines of text have been re-worked to improve them, such as the one displayed for selecting a new respawn point after your Hero has been killed.
[*]For players who have not yet registered a Block N Load display name and email address the two fields now contain examples of what information should be entered.
[*]Sarge’s Satchel charge is now named C4.[/list]
We all know the best way to see the changes is to witness them first-hand, so get in game and let us know your thoughts

notes.title: Build 673 - 27/01/2015
notes.content:
Hello Community!

This week we are bringing you a massive update. In addition to Old School Nigel completing the Skins for the Win DLC line-up, we've got two fresh arenas for you to cause mayhem in and numerous fixes and balancing tweaks.

[h1]Old School Nigel[/h1]

Ever wondered where Nigel was when we launched our Skins for the Win DLC Pack? So did we, until we got a call from his school principle, where he’s spent the last few weeks writing lines in detention.

He’s finally out, he’s really not sorry, and he’s headed in-game. Donning his finest old boys school uniform, it’s time to continue his destructive tendencies in an arena that won’t get him into all kinds of school trouble.

Don’t have Skins for the Win yet? [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/299360/?_ga=1.177806945.597848912.1416492162]Pre-order the Block N Load: Fully Loaded Edition[/url] on Steam for a ludicrously low price and get the entire Skins for the Win pack, Block N Load BETA access and a copy of Ace of Spades: Battle Builder.

If you haven’t played Block N Load yet, then there’s still time. Head over to our [url=https://www.blocknload.com/signup/]sign-up page[/url] now and try it out for yourself! 

[h1]Arenas[/h1]

[b]The Last Bastion[/b]

Two massive fortresses face off against each other with only a muddy pool and a single bridge to link them…  Sniping from on high, charging over the bridge, or tunneling underground to cause panic amongst the enemy, how you wreak havoc is entirely up to you! This is a large battlefield for larger than life characters, at this scale setting up small forward bases is crucial.

[b]Shuko Style[/b]

O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi isn’t the only character that’s right at home on this brand new arena! Building bridges or jumping from platform to platform provide just some of the alternative routes for you to utilize as you take out the enemy’s cube. Clever placement of radars will also warn your team of flanking attacks whilst well placed, hidden turrets can mow down enemy attackers before they get to your cube.

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[b]Sarge Stone[/b]

We've all been feeling that Sarge's Machine Gun was a little underpowered so we've made the following change in an attempt to fix this: 
[list]
[*]Sarge's Machine Gun damage has been increased by 25% (now 5 damage per bullet rather than 4 damage).
[/list]

[b]O.P. Juan Shinobi[/b]

We felt that O.P. was a little too strong so in an effort to remedy this we have made the following changes:
[list]
[*]OP’s Vanish Bomb ‘world damage’ reduced to 50 from 100. Damage to heroes, however, remains the same.
[*]OP’s Katana damage per hit has been reduced by 25%. However his overall DPS remains the same as we have increased his katana attack speed to compensate.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Cutting (collapsing blocks) resource income cap lowered to 1,500 from 2,000.
[/list]

[h1]New Feature[/h1]

We have added a new confirmation screen when you are queuing and a match is found. This addition is designed to help avoid people who have had to step away from their keyboard whilst in the queue but are being pulled into the match. It works as follows:
[list]
[*]Once a full match has been found a new confirmation interface will pop up in the middle of the screen stating 'Match Found'. 
[*]The interface will display the options 'Accept' and 'Decline'. Once all players have clicked accept you will move onto the 'Hero select screen'.
[*]If any of the players click 'Decline' or fail to click either option within the time limit they will be removed from the queue. NOTE: If you either select 'decline' or fail to respond several times, you will receive a demerit. So, ready up when you're ready to play.
[*]If this occurs, the remaining players will receive a message to inform them, and they will be placed back at the top of the queue.
[/list]

[h1]Crashes & Freezes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when certain elements in the map were collapsed
[/list]

[h1]Visual[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sarge’s Al Castone DLC skin player portrait now displays correctly rather than showing the default skin.
[*]Sarge’s Rocket Launcher model is now always correctly positioned when using the Al Castone DLC skin.
[*]Sarge’s jump animation has now been improved when using the Al Castone DLC skin.
[*]O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi’s arm no longer disappears when using Ninja Stars whilst using the 2080 Juan DLC skin (only occurred on rare occasions).
[*]The position of muzzle flash and smoke when Nigel fires his rifle has been improved.
[*]The brightness of Eliza’s digging tool has been reduced.
[*]Cube & Cube Core icons on the mini map have been updated to reflect the models in game.
[/list]

[h1]Chat[/h1]
[*]The chat channel is now set to 'team' by default.
[*]You can now type ‘/all’ or ‘/team’ at the start of a message to send it to all players or only your team respectively without changing your overall selected chat channel.
[*]Profanity filter is now applied to private messages.
[*]You can now press Shift+Enter to open the opposite channel to the channel you open when you press ‘Enter’.
[*]On the ‘TAB’ screen during a match you now have the option to click the speaker icon to mute or un-mute a player. NOTE: this can only be done during a match. Additionally, if you mute someone, they will NOT be able to message you anywhere in the game.
[*]You can now remove the chat box from matches via an interface option in the settings menu. (Settings > Interface > Show Chat In Match).
[*]Measures to prevent spam in chat have been implemented.
[*]Players will be alerted in the chat window if a player leaves the game.
[*]End of match chat has been made more prominent.
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Key binding improvements – There is now a greater variety of possible key bindings.
[*]End of game hover description text for ribbons have been improved.
[*]Re-binding controls while in a match no longer causes the action being bound to affect your hero behind the menu screen. E.g. binding a key to 'W' will no longer move your hero forward behind the menu.
[*]Players will no longer receive a message after a game incorrectly saying that they have lost merit due to abandoning a match.
[/list]

[h1]Menus[/h1]
[list]
[*]Descriptions of O.P. ‘Juan’ Shinobi’s active ability & katana have now been corrected in the ‘Learn’ & ‘Hero Selection’ screens.
[*]Description for the Heal Station in the ‘Learn’ section has been improved.
[*]Description for the Tiki Head in the ‘Learn’ section has been improved.
[*]In the ‘Settings’ menu you now have the option to remember a new matchmaking region before applying a change.
[/list]

[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*]General improvements to VO for the 'Skins for the Win DLC' skins.
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*]Surrender UI now correctly displays.
[*]The 'invite to squad' button in the friends menu now displays correctly.
[/list]

Have any thoughts on the latest game update? Let us know on our Steam Discussion Board.

notes.title: Build 659 - 06/01/2015
notes.content:
We have been busy checking over data and your messages on the board, and without further ado here are the latest patch notes for Block N Load Build 659!

[H1]Optimization[/H1]

As you may have seen throughout our Steam discussion forums, we’ve been looking for players to help us test Optimization changes. The tests have been fantastic, we thank you, and we’ve optimized in quite a few places to hopefully reduce: 
[list]
[*]Freezing while loading lobbies and maps
[*]“GameWin32.exe” crashes
[/list]
[H1]Bug Fixes[/H1]
[list]
[*]Your Profile should now display your actual Win Rate instead of displaying 100% or 0%.
[*]When reconnecting to a game, Block Resources & Player Score no longer resets to default. 
[*]Occasional double defeats when surrendering are now fixed.
[/list]
[H1]Balancing[/H1]

[b]Sarge Stone[/b]
Sarge was something of a rocket-tastic spam-monkey, and it involved an Ammo Box being placed next to Sarge while he consistently fired at an enemy base eventually breaking through. We’ve toned it down a little. Sarge’s Satchel has also received a small increase to damage but now takes longer to place and destroy. 
[list]
[*]Sarge’s Machine Gun bullet speed increased to 400 (from 150).
[*]Sarge’s Rocket Launcher range reduced to 70 (from 100).
[*]Sarge’s Rocket Launcher ammo pool reduced to 5, ammo restock rate slowed down to 0.2 (1 rocket takes 5s).
[*]Sarge’s Satchel build time set to 2s.
[*]Sarge’s Satchel hp set to 400 (4s defuse).
[*]Sarge’s Satchel hero & world damage increased to 200.
[*]Sarge’s Satchel fuse timer set to 15s (same as Large Bomb).
[/list]
[b]Cogwheel[/b]
Cog’s been bit of a multi-kill, doom-bringing monster robot, so we’ve eased down his passive to reduce his ability to stomp over everyone. Cogwheel’s Sprockets while looking great didn’t quite bring the power we wanted, as such his Mortar damage has received a sizeable damage buff - BOOM! However his radius has been reduced to improve the balance. Cogwheel also has had his engine tuned down and will move a little bit slower throughout the map.
[list]
[*]Cogwheel’s passive ability (Heavy Metal) heal bonus on hero loot pickups reduced to 25 (from 50)
[*]Cogwheel’s Sprocket (mortar) damage increased to 80, explosion radius reduced to 4.
[*]Cogwheel’s "force fall" (hold crouch mid-air to land quickly) disabled.
[*]Cogwheel’s sprint speed set to 5 (From 5.5).
[/list]
[b]Nigel[/b]
Nigel’s revolver has received a buff in bullet speed, the projectiles should travel much quicker to their target, Nigel has also had his Sprint Speed slightly nerfed.
[list]
[*]Nigel’s Revolver bullet speed increased to 400 (from 150).
[*]Nigel’s sprint speed set to 7 (From 7.5).
[/list]
[b]O.P.[/b]
Upon teleporting O.P. leaves behind his infamous Vanish Bomb, this Bomb has received a small buff to it’s world damage. Upon destruction of his Shrine a heal pickup will no longer drop. (Clue: it was never really meant to!)
[list]
[*]O.P.’s Vanish Bomb (left behind after teleporting via the active ability) world damage increased to 100, hero damage unchanged (100).
[*]O.P.’s Shrine no longer spawns a heal pickup on destruction.
[/list]
[b]Blocks[/b]
We’ve fine tuned some of our Blocks in-game, the major changes for this update are related to Respawn Points, Radars & Bombs.
[list]
[*]Wooden crate now costs 2 to place (salvage value 1).
[*]Bricks block now costs 10 to place (salvage value 5).
[*]Sandbag block now costs 15 to place (salvage value 7.5).
[*]Sandbag block now takes 1 second to place (Up from 0)
 - A common tactic is to sandbag yourself in while hitting an enemy cube, the time placement should reduce this tactic but also give Sandbags more meaning when placing them for defensive purposes.  There was really no previous downside to sandbags over bricks, but now there is.

[*]Respawn Points now have escalating costs. (+500 per additional device)
   - When sneaking around the back of a base you can begin to fill it up with Respawns, with the cost stacking players will now have to be more tactical with their Respawn placements due to the increasing cost.
[*]Radar cost upped to 400 (from 200).
[*]Destroying enemy Heal stations spawn a medikit pickup. This pick up has the same regeneration effect as a health pickup from a Hero death, but does not work with Cogwheel's passive.
[*]Destroying enemy Ammo crates spawn an ammo pickup. This pick up is equal to 5 seconds of ammo resupply.

[*]Bomb health set to 400 (4s defuse).
[*]Bomb hero & world damage increased to 200.
[*]Bomb build time reduced to 3s.
[*]Bomb fuse timer set to 15s (same as Large Bomb).

[*]Large Bomb build time reduced to 4s.
[*]Large Bomb hero & world damage increased to 400, hooray for big bombs    
  - BOOM, BOOM!
[/list]
[b]Health Pickups[/b] 
Picking up health has been changed. A health pack from a fallen hero will now provide health over 5 seconds instead of instantly. 

[b]Swimming[/b]
Our heroes were something of a cross between Michael Phelps and Ariel as they could move faster in water than out of it, and well, we felt that was just silly.
[list]
[*]Sarge swim speed set to 1.75, swim sprint set to 3.5.
[*]Cogwheel swim speed set to 1.25, swim sprint set to 2.5.
[*]Hunter swim speed set to 1.75, swim sprint set to 3.5.
[*]O.P. swim speed set to 2.25, swim sprint set to 4.
[*]Tony swim speed set to 1.75, swim sprint set to 3.5.
[*]Eliza swim speed set to 1.75, swim sprint set to 3.5.
[/list]

Get 2015 off to the best start – get the new update and get into a match today!

[*]When reconnecting to a game, Block Resources & Player Score no longer resets to default. 
[*]Occasional double defeats when surrendering are now fixed.
[/list]
[H1]Balancing[/H1]

[b]Sarge Stone[/b]
Sarge was something of a rocket-tastic spam-monkey, and it involved an Ammo Box being placed next to Sarge while he consistently fired at an enemy base eventually breaking through. We’ve toned it down a little. Sarge’s Satchel has also received a small increase to damage but now takes longer to place and destroy. 
[list]
[*]Sarge’s Machine Gun bullet speed increased to 400 (from 150).
[*]Sarge’s Rocket Launcher range reduced to 70 (from 100).
[*]Sarge’s Rocket Launcher ammo pool reduced to 5, ammo restock rate slowed down to 0.2 (1 rocket takes 5s).
[*]Sarge’s Satchel build time set to 2s.
[*]Sarge’s Satchel hp set to 400 (4s defuse).
[*]Sarge’s Satchel hero & world damage increased to 200.
[*]Sarge’s Satchel fuse timer set to 15s (same as Large Bomb).
[/list]
[b]Cogwheel[/b]
Cog’s been bit of a multi-kill, doom-bringing monster robot, so we’ve eased down his passive to reduce his ability to stomp over everyone. Cogwheel’s Sprockets while looking great didn’t quite bring the power we wanted, as such his Mortar damage has received a sizeable damage buff - BOOM! However his radius has been reduced to improve the balance. Cogwheel also has had his engine tuned down and will move a little bit slower throughout the map.
[list]
[*]Cogwheel’s passive ability (Heavy Metal) heal bonus on hero loot pickups reduced to 25 (from 50)
[*]Cogwheel’s Sprocket (mortar) damage increased to 80, explosion radius reduced to 4.
[*]Cogwheel’s "force fall" (hold crouch mid-air to land quickly) disabled.
[*]Cogwheel’s sprint speed set to 5 (From 5.5).
[/list]
[b]Nigel[/b]
Nigel’s revolver has received a buff in bullet speed, the projectiles should travel much quicker to their target, Nigel has also had his Sprint Speed slightly nerfed.
[list]
[*]Nigel’s Revolver bullet speed increased to 400 (from 150).
[*]Nigel’s sprint speed set to 7 (From 7.5).
[/list]
[b]O.P.[/b]
Upon teleporting O.P. leaves behind his infamous Vanish Bomb, this Bomb has received a small buff to it’s world damage. Upon destruction of his Shrine a heal pickup will no longer drop. (Clue: it was never really meant to!)
[list]
[*]O.P.’s Vanish Bomb (left behind after teleporting via the active ability) world damage increased to 100, hero damage unchanged (100).
[*]O.P.’s Shrine no longer spawns a heal pickup on destruction.
[/list]
[b]Blocks[/b]
We’ve fine tuned some of our Blocks in-game, the major changes for this update are related to Respawn Points, Radars & Bombs.
[list]
[*]Wooden crate now costs 2 to place (salvage value 1).
[*]Bricks block now costs 10 to place (salvage value 5).
[*]Sandbag block now costs 15 to place (salvage value 7.5).
[*]Sandbag block now takes 1 second to place (Up from 0)
 - A common tactic is to sandbag yourself in while hitting an enemy cube, the time placement should reduce this tactic but also give Sandbags more meaning when placing them for defensive purposes.  There was really no previous downside to sandbags over bricks, but now there is.

[*]Respawn Points now have escalating costs. (+500 per additional device)
   - When sneaking around the back of a base you can begin to fill it up with Respawns, with the cost stacking players will now have to be more tactical with their Respawn placements due to the increasing cost.
[*]Radar cost upped to 400 (from 200).
[*]Destroying enemy Heal stations spawn a medikit pickup. This pick up has the same regeneration effect as a health pickup from a Hero death, but does not work with Cogwheel's passive.
[*]Destroying enemy Ammo crates spawn an ammo pickup. This pick up is equal to 5 seconds of ammo resupply.

[*]Bomb health set to 400 (4s defuse).
[*]Bomb hero & world damage increased to 200.
[*]Bomb build time reduced to 3s.
[*]Bomb fuse timer set to 15s (same as Large Bomb).

[*]Large Bomb build time reduced to 4s.
[*]Large Bomb hero & world damage increased to 400, hooray for big bombs    
  - BOOM, BOOM!
[/list]
[b]Health Pickups[/b] 
Picking up health has been changed. A health pack from a fallen hero will now provide health over 5 seconds instead of instantly. 

[b]Swimming[/b]
Our heroes were something of a cross between Michael Phelps and Ariel as they could move faster in water than out of it, and well, we felt that was just silly.
[list]
[*]Sarge swim speed set to 1.75, swim sprint set to 3.5.
[*]Cogwheel swim speed set to 1.25, swim sprint set to 2.5.
[*]Hunter swim speed set to 1.75, swim sprint set to 3.5.
[*]O.P. swim speed set to 2.25, swim sprint set to 4.
[*]Tony swim speed set to 1.75, swim sprint set to 3.5.
[*]Eliza swim speed set to 1.75, swim sprint set to 3.5.
[/list]

Get 2015 off to the best start – get the new update and get into a match today!

notes.title: Build 643 AKA – Happy Holidays Blockheads!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://www.blocknload.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/santa_tony_467x181.jpg[/IMG]

Hey BETA Crew!

We’re just over a week into our closed BETA and a few days away from the holiday period…but that’s not stopping us!

Today we’re pleased to introduce another update to the Block N Load BETA, and one that’s packed with a host of tweaks, changes, nuts and bolts…plus a few surprises along the way.  That’s not all we’ve had to say this week either, if you’ve not done so already you should check out the [URL=http//steamcommunity.com/app/299360/discussions/0/626329820795008638]latest update from our Studio Head David Solari[/URL]. He’s opening up about some of our future plans for the game, as well as talking about some of the choices we’ve made.

[b]So what’s first up?[/b]

[h1]Santa Tony’s Winter Wonderland![/h1]

That’s right, snow has come to Block Land.  All grass and trees are now frosted, there is a winter skyline and it’s lightly snowing and almost always just outdoors.

Tony’s lil buddy has been replaced by Luigi the death dealing snowman.  He’s got Tony’s back and won’t let bases and generators go down without a fight.

Luigi will only be around to the 6th of January so enjoy him before he melts.

Yes there is more winter fun.  Santa Tony has come to town.  All you gotta do to get your hands on this special skin is play 20 [b]friendly[/b] matches between the 19th of December and the 6th of January and you will permanently own this exclusive and limited edition skin.  

[h1]New Maps![/h1]

We’ve made some changes to map rotations for the coming weeks. After looking at the maps you guys have been playing, we’ve decided to bench Stronghold for now. But, to compensate, we’ve decided to deliver not one, not two but THREE new maps in to the rotation. These are catchily titled: 

[list][*]Cube Cove
[*]Teeny Tiny
[*]Wilson Bay[/list]

Mountain Express and Heroes Playground will remain in the rotation bringing the total number of maps available to play to 5 for the coming sessions. 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

Roll up, roll up, get your fixes here! We’ve been crunching through a bunch of issues and have a host of new fixes going in to the game, some of our favorites are:

We think we’ve fixed the ‘100% loading lobby’ issue - We’ve received player reports on freezing when loading into a lobby at 100%, with this update this should now be fixed allowing you to get right into the action.  We’ve never been able to replicate it at Block HQ or at home so tracking the cause down has been hard and the only way to test the fix is put it live and wait for feedback.

[list][*]Fixed an issue with custom key bindings not saving after restarting the game.
[*]Fixed an issue regarding chat messages from another game appearing in your match.
[*]Fixed an issue where a notification shows on the Lobby Chat that there are messages, but when opened none are visible.
[*]Some players had noticed artifacts on grass and noticeable lines running along the edges of some blocks on high and very high graphics settings. This has been fixed.[/list]

[h1]Heroes Updates & Balancing[/h1]

We know you’ve been holding out for a hero… to soon? It’s been a big week for the Heroes of Block N Load and now that we’ve started to see some data coming through from the game play sessions we’ve massaged, moulded and pushed some changes through the heroes to adjust their balance and play.

So who got what? 

[b]Cogwheel:[/b]

Cog is tanky and really powerful from long range versus materials and infrastructure.  He’s also very strong in combat… basically he was too damn strong! So we’ve backed off some his combat effectiveness to balance out his mojo. . So the devil’s in the details:

[list][*]Cogwheel Rotary Cannon alt-fire spread has been increased.
[*]Cogwheel Rotary Cannon ammo pool reduced to 300 (from 500).
[*]Cogwheel Rotary Cannon resupply rate reduced to 20 (from 25).
[*]Cogwheel Passive Ability ammo resupply effect halved.
[*]Cogwheel Arm Cannon alt-fire radius lowered to 1.5 from 2, damage lowered to 30 from 40.[/list]

[b]Doc Eliza Doolally:[/b]

Eliza’s gas wasn’t quite as toxic as we’d been led to believe, so we sent her back to the lab. But we give with one and take with the other as we’ve dropped her heal down to restore the yin and the yang. .

[list][*]Eliza Gas Cloud damage increased.
[*]Eliza Bubble Gun ammo pool reduced to 40 (from 42).
[*]Eliza active heal toned down to 50 points.[/list]

[b]Nigel Purdey-Longshott:[/b]

Nigel’s Tiki Heads were lacking Juju, so we’ve done some black magic and they should now be much more useful…so use them already!   We’ve also buffed his firearms slightly, so they’re a little more…you know…deadly.

[list][*]Nigel Rifle ammo pool reduced to 28 (from 30).
[*]Nigel Rifle base damage increased to 40 (from 35).
[*]Nigel Revolver moving accuracy penalty lowered.
[*]Nigel Revolver ammo pool reduced to 36 (from 48).
[*]Nigel Revolver resupply rate reduced to 3 (from 6).
[*]Tiki Head fire rate increased to 1 shot per second (from 1 per 5s).
[*]Tiki Head now shoots 4 darts in a 10 degree spread (upped from single shot).
[*]Tiki Head dart projectile speed increased to 100 (from 20).
[*]Tiki Head now has movement prediction in its aiming AI.
[*]Tiki Head dart projectile timeout reduced to 1s from 5s.[/list]

[b]O.P. Juan Shinobi:[/b]

O.P. is a slippery devil so when we finally managed to pin him down, we just managed to make some small changes to his kit before he vanished in a puff of smoke.

[list][*]O.P.  Shuko (claws) timings tweaked.
[*]O.P.  Katana timings tweaked.
[*]O.P.  Katana damage slightly increased due to timing changes.
[*]O.P.  Katana range increased to 3.
[*]O.P.  Katana altfire (smoke bomb teleport) ammo pool increased to 4 (from 3).
[*]O.P.  Katana altfire (smoke bomb teleport) resupply rate lowered to 0.25 (from 0.5).
[*]O.P.  Shuriken ammo pool increased to 48 (from 45).
[*]O.P.  Shuriken resupply rate lowered to 3 (from 5).
[*]O.P.  Active ability progression adjusted due to ammo changes.[/list]

[b]Sarge Stone:[/b]

Our Sarge ain’t the brightest but he’s got his sh*t together pretty well right now, so we’ve not made too many changes to him this time around.

[list][*]Sarge Rocket Launcher splash *world* damage toned down to 40 from 60, 20 points of direct World damage added back. Player damage remains unchanged (40 splash).[/list]

[b]Tony Turretto:[/b]

Tony T’s mamma came round to tell us what’s what so now we’re making sure her special little boy is well rewarded for all the hard work that he’s doing cracking out those headshots.

[list][*]Tony Rivet Gun has 25% bonus damage on headshots (upped from 0% from last week).
[*]Tony Rivet Gun ammo pool reduced to 36.
[*]Tony Rivet Gun resupply rate reduced to 2.[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]

And last but not least – we’ve got our blocks n our building… all of which have seen some small tweaks and updates to just make it that little bit tougher.  

[b]Blocks:[/b]

[list][*]Bear Trap salvage value normalized.
[*]Grass block durability normalized.
[*]Caltrops damage and tick rate lowered to 3 ticks per second * 7 damage.
[*]Mud block toughness removed, mining value normalized.[/list]

[b]Building:[/b]

[list][*]All tool dig & build ranges normalized to 3 units.[/list]

O.P. Katana altfire (smoke bomb teleport) ammo pool increased to 4 (from 3).
O.P. Katana altfire (smoke bomb teleport) resupply rate lowered to 0.25 (from 0.5).
O.P. Shuriken ammo pool increased to 48 (from 45).
O.P. Shuriken resupply rate lowered to 3 (from 5).
O.P. Active ability progression adjusted due to ammo changes.
Sarge Rocket Launcher splash *world* damage toned down to 40 from 60, 20 points of direct World damage added back.
Tony Rivet Gun has 25% bonus damage on headshots (upped from 0% from last week).
Tony Rivet Gun ammo pool reduced to 36.
Tony Rivet Gun resupply rate reduced to 2.
Bear Trap salvage value normalized.
Grass block durability normalized.
Caltrops damage and tick rate lowered to 3 ticks per second * 7 damage.
Mud block toughness removed, mining value normalized.
All tool dig & build ranges normalized to 3 units.

notes.title: Build 626 - 12/12/2014
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

In order to help improve your Beta experience we're currently in the process of launching a hotfix which brings in the following additional improvements to the Block N Load Beta.

As a result of this the Block N Load Game Servers are down for maintenance, with downtime lasting up to a minimum of 1 hour.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] In rare instances when looking at the highscores in-game you may of seen more than five players on the opposite side, this is now fixed.
[*] Some players had issues where they couldn't login to the game in rare cases, this has now been resolved
[*] An issue where you couldn't view  the end-game lobby has now been fixed.
[*] A rare problem where players could still play the game after the match ending has been fixed, this also fixes the issues with being unable to select and lock in when going to a new lobby as they contributed to this.
[/list]
[h1]New Cube Models[/h1]

The new update brings in these newly designed Cube Models, enforcing the need to protect or destroy the objectives.

[b]Cube[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xl3u00q.png[/img]

[b]Cube Core[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/lQqbXYJ.png[/img]

Thanks,

The Block N Load Community Team.
